UNV word order in second clause: 現在[你的妻子][在這裡]; LCC reorders to 如今[你看][你的妻子], following Hebrew order (וְעַתָּה הִנֵּה אִשְׁתְּךָ) more closely — SNs map correctly in LCC order

帶走 in LCC is a compound verb corresponding to two Hebrew words קַח (H3947) and לֵךְ (H3212); annotated separately (帶<WH03947><WTH8798>走<WH03212><WTH8798>) to preserve one-to-one Hebrew lexeme correspondence

Gen/12.lcc_sn: 於是法老<WH06547>爲了亞伯蘭的事<WAH05921>就吩咐<WH06680><WTH8762>人<WH0582>將亞伯蘭<WAH0853>和<WAH0853>他的妻子<WH0802>、以及<WAH0853>他<WAH09001>一切<WAH03605>所有的<WAH0834>都送走了<WH07971><WTH8762>。
Gen/12.lcc_original: 於是法老爲了亞伯蘭的事就吩咐人將亞伯蘭和他的妻子、以及他一切所有的都送走了。
notes: UNV has {<WAH05921>} implicit (H5921 = עַל, upon/concerning), but LCC makes it explicit with 爲了亞伯蘭的事; braces dropped and tag attached after 事 per rule 3.
LCC adds 一切 where UNV has no direct counterpart; H3605 (כֹּל = all) assigned to 一切 rather than 都, since 都 in this LCC context is a reinforcing aspect particle with no residual Hebrew equivalent.
UNV 並<WAH0853> maps to LCC 以及<WAH0853>; both conjunctions introduce the third direct object (אֵת כֹּל).
LCC 就 before 吩咐 is an aspect/sequential particle with no Hebrew equivalent; left unannotated.

Gen/13.lcc_sn: 亞伯蘭<WH087>從<WAH04480>埃及<WH04714>上<WH05927><WTH8799>南地<WH05045>去，他<WAH01931>和他妻子<WH0802>、跟他一切<WAH03605>所有的<WAH0834><WAH09001>、以及羅得<WH03876>、都和他同行<WAH05973>。
Gen/13.lcc_original: 亞伯蘭從埃及上南地去，他和他妻子、跟他一切所有的、以及羅得、都和他同行。
notes: Rule 3 applied to {<WAH01931>}: LCC makes the implicit Hebrew pronoun הוּא explicit as 他, so braces are dropped → 他<WAH01931>
H5973 (עִמּוֹ, 'with him') assigned to 同行: UNV's 帶著 (bringing along) is restructured in LCC into the final clause 都和他同行; 同行 carries the accompanying-movement sense of עִמּוֹ
跟他 in 跟他一切所有的 left untagged: LCC elaboration not matching any unaccounted Hebrew lexeme (כָּל אֲשֶׁר לוֹ is already covered by 一切<WAH03605>所有的<WAH0834><WAH09001>)
去 left untagged: Chinese resultative complement of the 上…去 verb complex; no separate Hebrew lexeme

Gen/13.lcc_original: 亞伯蘭有牲畜金銀極多。
notes: LCC adds 有 for Chinese fluency (no Hebrew equivalent); left unannotated
LCC reorders to 牲畜金銀, following Hebrew word order (מִקְנֶה→כֶּסֶף→זָהָב) vs UNV's 金銀牲畜; each noun retains its own WAH09002 prefix tag
WAH09002 prefix represents Hebrew ב (in/with) on each noun; the preposition is implicit in LCC's 有 construction but SNs attach to individual nouns per the rules

Gen/13.lcc_original: 他從南地按着路站走，直到伯特利，到了伯特利和艾的中間，他起先支搭帳棚的地方，
notes: LCC '按着路站' explicitly renders the implicit {<WAH09001>}{<WH04550>} (לְמַסָּעָיו, 'by his journeys/stages') — braces dropped, both SNs attached to 路站 since the concept is overtly expressed.
UNV restructures Hebrew word order as 往<WAH05704>伯特利去<WH03212><WTH8799>; LCC reorders to 走，直到伯特利 — WH03212+WTH8799 go to 走, WAH05704 goes to 直到.
LCC uses 他起先 instead of UNV's 從前 for Hebrew בַּתְּחִלָּה — WAH09002+WH08462 attached to 起先.
LCC omits the Hebrew copula הָיָה (was/had been, WH01961+WTH8804) entirely — kept as implicit {<WH01961><WTH8804>} placed between 的 and 地方 where it falls in the relative clause.
WAH0834 (relative pronoun אֲשֶׁר) attached to 的 (Chinese relative clause nominalizer), which is its functional equivalent in LCC's restructured clause.
שָׁם 'there' (WAH08033) has no explicit counterpart in LCC — kept as implicit marker after 到了<WAH05704>.

Gen/13.lcc_original: 他先前造祭壇的地方；在那裏亞伯蘭呼求永恆主的名。
notes: UNV opens with '也是<WAH0834><WAH08033>' (the relative-locative connector for אֲשֶׁר + first שָׁם); LCC drops this connector entirely. H834 (אֲשֶׁר, relative pronoun) is attached to 的, the Chinese relative-clause particle. The first H8033 (שָׁם 'there' within the relative clause) has no explicit LCC word and is kept as implicit {<WAH08033>}.
LCC names the subject explicitly as '亞伯蘭' where UNV uses pronoun '他' bearing <WH087>; H87 is attached to 亞伯蘭 in the second clause.
LCC '永恆主' (Eternal Lord) is a paraphrase of יְהוָה where UNV has '耶和華'; H3068 is attached to 永恆主 as a single lexical unit.
LCC '先前' matches UNV '起先' for בָּרִאשֹׁנָה (H7223 = רִאשׁוֹן with WAH09002 beth-prefix); '造' matches '築' for H6213 (עָשָׂה); '祭壇' matches '壇' for H4196 (מִזְבֵּחַ).

Gen/13.lcc_original: 跟亞伯蘭同行的羅得也有羊羣牛羣和帳棚。
notes: LCC reverses the order of cattle and sheep relative to UNV (UNV: 牛群、羊群; LCC: 羊羣牛羣) — SNs WH01241 and WH06629 follow LCC word order accordingly
UNV 與 → LCC 跟 (both mean 'with/together with'); WH0854 attaches to 跟
LCC 和 (conjunction before 帳棚) is a Chinese addition with no Hebrew equivalent — left unannotated

Gen/13.lcc_original: 那地容不下他們住在一起；因他們的活財物很多，他們便不能住在一起。
notes: UNV implicit markers {<WH03162>}{<WAH09001>}{<WH03427>}{<WTH8800>} (together + dwell infinitive) become explicit in LCC as 住在一起; per Rule 3, braces dropped and all four tags appended after the phrase per Rule 6 (one LCC phrase covers multiple Hebrew roots)
LCC 活財物 vs UNV 財物: LCC's 活 is an interpretive gloss on רְכוּשׁ (livestock/property), so WH07399 attaches to the full phrase 活財物
{<WAH01961>}{<WTH8804>} (הָיָה, was/became) remains implicit — LCC 因他們的活財物很多 also has no explicit copula
LCC 因 vs UNV 因為: both render כִּי (WAH03588), shorter form in LCC only

Gen/13.lcc_original: 牧養亞伯蘭牲畜的人和牧養羅得牲畜的人就起了分爭。當時迦南人和比利洗人住在那地。
notes: LCC reverses sentence order relative to Hebrew/UNV: the strife clause appears first, then the Canaanite/Perizzite residence clause.

WAH01961 (וַיְהִי = 'there arose') split from WH07379 (רִיב = strife): WAH01961 attaches to 起了 (the verb 'arose') and WH07379 attaches to 分爭 (the noun 'contention'), whereas UNV combined both onto 相爭.

First {<WAH0996>} (בֵּין = 'between', first occurrence) kept as implicit tag inserted before 牧養亞伯蘭 since LCC has no explicit corresponding word; the 和 connecting the two groups carries the second WAH0996 (וּבֵין).
Both {<WH04735>} occurrences (מִקְנֵה = livestock) are explicit as 牲畜 in LCC — braces dropped and tag attached directly.
LCC uses the verbal phrase 牧養…的人 ('those who tend') rather than UNV's nominal 牧人 ('herdsman'); WH07462 (רֹעֵי, Qal active participle) attaches to 牧養 in each occurrence, preserving WTH8802 morphology.

Gen/13.lcc_original: 亞伯蘭就對羅得說：『你我之間、不可分爭；你牧人和我牧人之間、也不可分爭，因爲我們是族弟兄。
notes: WAH0996 (בֵּין, between) moved from 你我 in UNV to 之間 in LCC — 之間 is the explicit Chinese word for 'between', which UNV did not use; the SN naturally attaches there instead.

Double WAH0996 on 之間 in clause 2: LCC's single 之間 compresses both Hebrew occurrences of וּבֵין ('and between your shepherds and between my shepherds') — the formerly-implicit {WAH0996} before 你牧人 drops its braces since 之間 is explicit in LCC.

族弟兄 carries both WH0582 (אֲנָשִׁים, men/kinsmen) and WH0251 (אַחִים, brothers) — LCC renders the Hebrew compound 'kinsmen-brothers' as a single compound word 族弟兄 rather than UNV's 骨肉 + parenthetical note.
{<WAH04994>} (נָא, please) and {<WH01961>}{<WTH8799>} (תְהִי, let there be) kept implicit — LCC has no explicit words corresponding to them, same as UNV.

Gen/13.lcc_original: 所有的地不都在你面前麼？請離開我！你左，我就向右；你右，我就向左。』
notes: UNV 遍<WAH03605>地<WH0776> → LCC 所有的<WAH03605>地<WH0776>: '所有的' is the all/every morpheme (כֹּל H3605), '地' is the land morpheme (אֶרֶץ H776) — split preserved across the two-word LCC rendering.
UNV 眼前 → LCC 面前: both render Hebrew לִפְנֵי (lamed prefix WAH09001 + פָּנִים WH06440); tags attached after 面前.
UNV 請你離開我 → LCC 請離開我!: LCC elides the explicit subject 你; 請 receives WAH04994, 離開 receives WH06504+WTH8734, 我 receives WAH04480+WAH05921.
UNV 你向左/你向右 → LCC 你左/你右: LCC drops directional 向; direction nouns 左/右 receive the respective SNs (WH08040, WH03225).
Both {<WAH0518>} implicit conditional markers retained as braced — LCC also omits an explicit conditional word in both clauses.

Gen/13.lcc_original: 羅得舉目，看見約但河那一片平原，沿到瑣珥的路向，各處水源充足，在永恆主還沒有毀滅所多瑪蛾摩拉以前，就像永恆主的園子，就像埃及地一樣。
notes: LCC renders יְהוָה (WH03068) as 永恆主 instead of UNV's 耶和華 — both occurrences annotated consistently.
LCC's 那一片 corresponds to UNV's 的全 (כֹּל, WAH03605); WAH03605 attached to 那一片 and WH03603 to 平原 separately.
WAH03588 (כִּי introductory particle) and WAH03605 (כֹּל = all) both attached to 各處, since LCC condenses 'for all of it is well-watered' into 各處水源充足.
WH0935+WTH8800 (בּוֹא inf. cstr. = reaching as far as) attached to 沿到, which captures the directional extent sense of UNV's 直到.
LCC adds 的路向 after 瑣珥 (lit. 'in the direction of the road toward Zoar') — no Hebrew equivalent, left unannotated.
LCC adds 一樣 at the end of the final simile — no Hebrew equivalent, left unannotated.
Both אֵת (WAH0853) instances before proper nouns (Sodom, Gomorrah) remain in braces since LCC has no explicit object marker word for them.

Gen/13.lcc_original: 於是羅得選擇了約但河那一片平原，向東邊往前行，他們就彼此分離了。
notes: LCC 選擇了: SN tags placed after 選擇 and before aspect particle 了, as 了 has no Hebrew equivalent
LCC 那一片 maps to UNV/Hebrew כֹּל (WAH03605, 'all/whole'); LCC uses demonstrative+measure word construction (那一片) rather than 全
LCC 向東邊往前行 rephrases UNV 往東遷移: 向東邊 ← WAH04480+WH06924 (eastward direction), 往前行 ← WH05265+WTH8799 (journeyed/moved on)
Implicit markers {<WAH0853>} (accusative marker ʾēt), {<WAH09001>} (waw conjunction), {<WH03876>} (Lot as resumed subject) all kept in braces — LCC has no explicit words for them

Gen/13.lcc_original: 亞伯蘭住在迦南地，羅得住在那片平原的城市，漸漸搬着帳棚，直到所多瑪。
notes: LCC inserts 那片 (demonstrative 'that') before 平原; WH03603 attaches after 平原 as the head noun.
城邑 (UNV) → 城市 (LCC): synonym pair, SNs WAH09002+WH05892 transfer without issue.
挪移帳棚 (UNV) → 搬着帳棚 (LCC): 搬着 replaces 挪移 with aspect particle 着; WH0167 (אָהַל, to pitch/tent) and morphology WTH8799 placed after 帳棚, mirroring UNV tag position.

Gen/13.lcc_sn: 說到所多瑪<WH05467>人<WH0582>，他們是壞人<WH07451>，是大大<WH03966>悖逆永恆主<WAH09001><WH03068>的罪人<WH02400>。
Gen/13.lcc_original: 說到所多瑪人，他們是壞人，是大大悖逆永恆主的罪人。
notes: 說到 is LCC's introductory phrase with no Hebrew lexical equivalent — left unannotated
悖逆 is LCC's syntactic bridge expressing חַטָּאִים לַ ('sinners against'); it carries no independent SN — left unannotated
WAH09001+WH03068 attached to 永恆主 (LCC's rendering of יהוה); the ל prefix directional meaning is expressed syntactically by the 悖逆…的 construction rather than a dedicated word
大大 assigned WH03966 (מְאֹד = exceedingly) as its semantic correspondent; in LCC it modifies 悖逆 rather than standing sentence-finally as in UNV
他們是 and 是 copular constructions are LCC additions for Chinese grammatical fluency — unannotated

Gen/13.lcc_original: 羅得離別了亞伯蘭以後，永恆主對亞伯蘭說：『從你所在的地方，你舉目向北、向南、向東、向西觀看！
notes: 耶和華 (WH03068) → 永恆主: LCC renders the Tetragrammaton as 永恆主; SN attached to the full 永恆主 phrase
Direction order differs: UNV has 東西南北 (E W S N), LCC has 北南東西 (N S E W); SNs reassigned by semantic match — 向北<WH06828>, 向南<WH05045>, 向東<WH06924>, 向西<WH03220>
LCC inserts aspect particle 了 after 離別 (no Hebrew equivalent); SN placed immediately after 離別 before 了, leaving 了 unannotated
{<WAH04480>}{<WAH05973>} remain implicit after 亞伯蘭: LCC likewise does not render the Hebrew prepositions מֵ (from) and עִמּוֹ (with) explicitly

Gen/13.lcc_original: 你所看見的一切地，我都要賜給你和你的後裔，直到永遠。
notes: UNV 凡<WAH03588> (H3588/כִּי, introductory particle 'for/indeed') has no corresponding word in LCC, which omits it as a stylistic choice; treated as implicit and prepended as {<WAH03588>}. All remaining tokens align 1:1 between UNV and LCC with identical word order and phrasing.

Gen/13.lcc_original: 我要使你的後裔像地上的塵沙那麼多；若有人能數得清地上的塵沙，你的後裔也就能數得清。
notes: 使 receives WH07760+WTH8804 (שׂוּם qal perfect); LCC omits 也 after 我 — no SN lost since 也 in UNV carries no SN.
{WAH0853} kept implicit in both positions: LCC has no explicit direct-object particle (את) in either clause.
WAH09003 (כְּ comparison prefix) attached to 塵沙 rather than to 像, following the UNV pattern where the prefix tag rides on the noun 塵沙 rather than on the standalone comparison word.
LCC's 有 in 若有人 is a Chinese grammatical addition with no Hebrew equivalent; 人 alone receives WH0376 (אִישׁ).
{WH0834} (אֲשֶׁר) kept as implicit marker before the conditional clause; LCC uses a semicolon instead of an explicit relative pronoun.
LCC's 也就能數得清 (second clause): 也 alone receives WAH01571 (גַּם with conjunction); 就 and 能 are Chinese fluency words with no Hebrew equivalent; 數得清 receives WH04487+WTH8735 (יִמָּנֶה niphal imperfect).

Gen/13.lcc_original: 你起來，縱橫走遍這地，因爲我都要賜給你。』
notes: LCC combines 縱橫 as a single compound where UNV annotates each character separately (H0753 length, H7341 width); all four SN tags appended to the compound per Rule 6
LCC 都要 (modal/aspect) expands UNV 必 with no Hebrew equivalent — left unannotated
LCC uses traditional 因爲 vs UNV 因為; <WAH03588> (כִּי) attached after 因爲 unchanged

Gen/13.lcc_sn: 亞伯蘭<WH087>就搬了帳棚<WH0167><WTH8799>，來<WH0935><WTH8799>到希伯崙<WAH09002><WH02275>幔利<WH04471>的聖篤耨香樹【1】<WAH09002><WH0436>那裏<WAH0834>住下<WH03427><WTH8799>；在那裏<WAH08033>他給永恆主<WAH09001><WH03068>築<WH01129><WTH8799>了一座祭壇<WH04196>。
Gen/13.lcc_original: 亞伯蘭就搬了帳棚，來到希伯崙幔利的聖篤耨香樹【1】那裏住下；在那裏他給永恆主築了一座祭壇。
notes: LCC 聖篤耨香樹【1】 (with footnote marker) = UNV 橡樹 = H0436 (אֵלוֹן/אַלּוֹן, oak/terebinth); SN placed after full term including 【1】
LCC adds explicit subject pronoun 他 before 築; it is grammatically embedded in the Hebrew verb form and has no SN — left unannotated
LCC 永恆主 (Eternal Lord) = UNV 耶和華 = YHWH; WAH09001+WH03068 attached to 永恆主, with 給 functioning as the preposition corresponding to the lamed prefix encoded in WAH09001
LCC 住下 = UNV 居住 = WH03427 (יָשַׁב, dwell); both carry WTH8799 morphology tag
LCC 祭壇 = UNV 壇 = WH04196 (מִזְבֵּחַ, altar); LCC uses the fuller compound term

Gen/14.lcc_original: 當暗拉非做示拿王，亞畧做以拉撒王，基大老瑪做以攔王，提達做戈印王的日子，
notes: WH01961+WTH8799 (וַיְהִי 'and it came to pass') kept implicit {braces} — LCC has no explicit word for it; the 當…的日子 construction absorbs it just as UNV's 當…的時候 does.
LCC 亞畧 vs UNV 亞略 and LCC 做 vs UNV 作 are orthographic/lexical variants with no effect on SN alignment.
LCC 日子 is more literal for WH03117 (יוֹם, 'day') than UNV's 時候 ('time/occasion'); WAH09002 (prefix ב) and WH03117 both attached together to 的日子 following the same post-phrase convention used in UNV.
All four king-name/kingdom/王 triplets map 1-to-1 with no ambiguity.

Gen/14.lcc_original: 他們向所多瑪王比銳，蛾摩拉王比沙，押瑪王示納，洗扁王善以別，和比拉王，就是瑣珥王──作戰。
notes: LCC restructures sentence order: 向[kings]──作戰 vs UNV's 攻打[kings]. 作戰 absorbs both <WH06213> (עָשָׂה, make/wage) and <WH04421> (מִלְחָמָה, war); morphology <WTH8804> follows the verb.
UNV's implicit {<WH0854>} (אֵת, object/preposition marker) maps to LCC's explicit 向 (against/toward); braces dropped per rule 3: 向<WH0854>.
LCC's 比銳 is a different transliteration of UNV's 比拉 (H01298, Bera, king of Sodom); same person, different character choice — <WH01298> assigned to 比銳.
{<WAH0854>} retained as implicit after the first comma (before 蛾摩拉), as LCC uses only a comma for the conjunction and has no explicit word for it.
LCC adds 王 after 瑣珥 (就是瑣珥王) with no Hebrew equivalent in UNV tagging; left unannotated.

Gen/14.lcc_original: 這些王在西訂山谷會合；那就是鹽海。
notes: H03605 (כֹּל, 'all'): UNV uses 都 as a dedicated quantifier; LCC omits it, so WAH03605 is co-attached to 這些 alongside WAH0428, since 這些 subsumes the 'all these' meaning of כָּל-אֵלֶּה.
WH01931 (הוּא, 'that/it is'): UNV anchors to 就是; LCC uses 那就是 where 那 is the pronoun הוּא — placed on 那 as the closer lexical match.
LCC 山谷 vs UNV 谷: both render H06010 (עֵמֶק, valley); the fuller LCC form absorbs the tag without issue.
UNV 五王 ('five kings') has no SN tag and reflects contextual bridging from v.2; LCC likewise has 王 unannotated — consistent.

Gen/14.lcc_original: 他們服事了基大老瑪十二年，到十三年就背叛了。
notes: UNV 事奉 / LCC 服事 are synonymous verbs for the same Hebrew root <WH05647>; alignment is unambiguous.
<WH0853> is the direct object marker (אֵת) with no explicit LCC word; kept as {<WH0853>} per implicit-marker rule.
SN tags placed immediately after the content word (服事, 背叛) and before the trailing aspect particle 了, consistent with rule 1.
他們 carries no SN in UNV (subject encoded in the Hebrew verb conjugation); left unannotated in LCC as well.
十二/十三 number compounds (two-SN each) assigned directly to the corresponding LCC numerals with no rephrasing.

Gen/14.lcc_original: 十四年基大老瑪和同盟的王都來，在亞特律加寧擊敗了利乏音人，在哈麥擊敗了蘇西人，在沙微基列亭擊敗了以米人，
notes: {<WAH0834>}{<WAH0854>} kept as implicit: LCC's 同盟 is a semantic paraphrase of Hebrew אֲשֶׁר אִתּוֹ ('who were with him'), not a direct lexical match for either particle individually; neither 和 nor 同盟 corresponds cleanly to a single one of these grammatical particles
UNV 殺敗了 → LCC 擊敗了: synonymous verbs (both = 'to strike/defeat'); SN tags <WH05221><WTH8686> transferred to 擊敗了 in all three instances
{<WAH0853>} (object marker אֵת) kept implicit throughout — LCC has no explicit particle corresponding to it, just as UNV does not
LCC omits middle dots in place names (亞特律加寧, 沙微基列亭 vs UNV 亞特律‧加寧, 沙微‧基列亭); treated as same proper nouns receiving the same SNs

Gen/14.lcc_sn: 在何利人<WH02752>的西珥<WH08165>山<WAH09002><WH02042>擊敗了{<WAH0853>}何利人，一直<WAH05704>追擊到靠近<WH05921>曠野<WH04057>的<WAH0834>伊勒巴蘭<WH0364>。
Gen/14.lcc_original: 在何利人的西珥山擊敗了何利人，一直追擊到靠近曠野的伊勒巴蘭。
Gen/14.unv_sn_reference: 在何利人<WH02752>的西珥<WH08165>山<WAH09002><WH02042>殺敗了{<WAH0853>}何利人，一直<WAH05704>殺到靠近<WH05921>曠野<WH04057>的<WAH0834>伊勒‧巴蘭<WH0364>。
notes: 殺到 (UNV) → 追擊到 (LCC): LCC adds 追擊 ('pursued') where UNV has 殺 ('struck'); neither carries a SN in the source, so no annotation is inserted.
{<WAH0853>} kept implicit: H853 is the Hebrew direct-object marker (את); LCC likewise absorbs it grammatically with no explicit word.
伊勒巴蘭: LCC omits the interpunct (‧) present in UNV's 伊勒‧巴蘭; <WH0364> attaches to the full proper name as a unit.

Gen/14.lcc_original: 然後轉到安密巴，就是加低斯，擊毀了亞瑪力人的各鄉間，又擊敗了住在哈洗遜他瑪的亞摩利人。
notes: 然後 is LCC's own transitional connective with no Hebrew SN counterpart; WH07725+WTH8799 attaches to 轉 (returned/turned back).
LCC splits UNV's single verb 殺敗了 (WH05221+WTH8686) into two verbs: 擊毀了 (tagged) and 擊敗了 (untagged, LCC stylistic expansion for the second object); WH05221+WTH8686 assigned to first verb only.
LCC 各鄉間 maps to UNV 全地的人 (all the people of the land): 各=WAH03605 (כֹּל all), 鄉間=WH07704 (שָׂדֶה field/countryside).
LCC 又 maps to UNV 以及 (WAH01931=גַּם, and also).
WAH09002 (ב preposition prefix) and WH02688 (Hazezon-tamar root) both placed after 哈洗遜他瑪, following UNV's compound-token grouping convention.

Gen/14.lcc_original: 於是所多瑪王、蛾摩拉王、押瑪王、洗扁王、和比拉王、就是瑣珥王、都出來，在西訂山谷擺陣，和他們交戰；
notes: LCC restructures the parenthetical '（比拉就是瑣珥）' as '、就是瑣珥王、' integrated into the king list without brackets; <WAH01931> placed on 就是 and <WH06820> on 瑣珥 accordingly; the extra 王 after 瑣珥 is LCC's own stylistic addition (no distinct Hebrew source word) and is left unannotated.
LCC writes 山谷 (valley) where UNV writes 谷; both <WAH09002> (prefix particle) and <WH06010> (עֵמֶק, valley) are attached to 山谷 as a single unit representing the same Hebrew phrase.
UNV uses 與 (with) while LCC uses 和 as conjunction; <WAH0854> (אֵת with pronominal suffix = with-them) follows UNV positioning and is placed after 他們 rather than on 和.

Gen/14.lcc_original: 就是和以攔王基大老瑪、戈印王提達、示拿王暗拉非、以拉撒王亞畧、交戰：四個王和五個王交戰。
notes: 與→和: WAH0854 attached to 和 in both occurrences (LCC consistently uses 和 instead of 與 for the preposition 'with')
亞略→亞畧: LCC uses the variant character 畧; same name Arioch, WH0746 aligns clearly
四個/五個: LCC adds the measure word 個 after the numeral; SN attached after the full numeral phrase (四個, 五個) since the whole phrase represents the Hebrew word
UNV 乃是 (transitional phrase before 四王) carries no SN, so its omission from LCC causes no annotation loss

Gen/14.lcc_original: 西訂山谷有許多石漆坑；所多瑪王和蛾摩拉王逃跑，有掉在坑裏的，其餘的人都往山上逃跑。
notes: LCC has '山谷' (mountain valley) where UNV has bare '谷': H07708 (שִׂדִּים, Siddim) → 西訂, H06010 (עֵמֶק, valley) → 山谷, attaching each SN to its respective component.
{<WAH08033>} (שָׁם, 'there') kept implicit — LCC has no explicit locative adverb corresponding to it, just as UNV does not.
LCC semicolon (；) after first clause preserved exactly as written; UNV period (。) not substituted.

Gen/14.lcc_sn: 四個王就把<WAH0853>所多瑪<WH05467>和蛾摩拉<WH06017>所有的<WAH03605>財物<WH07399>跟<WAH0853>一切<WAH03605>糧食<WH0400>都拿<WH03947><WTH8799>了走<WH03212><WTH8799>，
Gen/14.lcc_original: 四個王就把所多瑪和蛾摩拉所有的財物跟一切糧食都拿了走，
Gen/14.unv_sn_reference: 四王就把<WAH0853>所多瑪<WH05467>和蛾摩拉<WH06017>所有的<WAH03605>財物<WH07399>，並<WAH0853>一切的<WAH03605>糧食<WH0400>都擄掠<WH03947><WTH8799>去<WH03212><WTH8799>了；
notes: 擄掠(H03947)+去(H03212) → 拿(H03947)+走(H03212): LCC uses the serial verb 拿…走 where UNV uses 擄掠…去; semantic correspondence is sound (לָקַח = take, הָלַךְ = go/depart). The aspect particle 了 between them has no Hebrew equivalent and is left unannotated per Rule 5.
Second <WAH0853> (את direct-object marker) placed after the conjunction 跟 and before 一切, mirroring the UNV positional pattern (並<WAH0853>一切的).
LCC omits the structural particle 的 after 一切 compared to UNV 一切的; the <WAH03605> tag attaches to 一切 directly.
LCC 四個王 adds measure word 個 vs UNV 四王; no SN tags assigned to these words as none appear in the UNV source for this phrase.

Gen/14.lcc_sn: 也把<WAH0853>亞伯蘭<WH087>弟兄<WH0251>的兒子<WH01121>羅得和<WAH0853>羅得<WH03876>的財物<WH07399>都拿<WH03947><WTH8799>了走<WH03212><WTH8799>。當時羅得<WAH01931>正住<WH03427><WTH8802>在所多瑪<WAH09002><WH05467>。
Gen/14.lcc_original: 也把亞伯蘭弟兄的兒子羅得和羅得的財物都拿了走。當時羅得正住在所多瑪。
notes: LCC 弟兄的兒子 is a literal rendering of the Hebrew (אֲחִי + בֶּן), while UNV uses the idiomatic 姪兒 (nephew); H251 → 弟兄, H1121 → 兒子.
The second <WAH0853> (second Hebrew אֵת accusative marker) is placed after 和, since LCC has only one 把 covering both objects; this preserves the marker before the second direct object phrase.
LCC 拿了走 replaces UNV 擄掠去了: 拿<WH03947> = H3947 (לָקַח, take), 走<WH03212> = H3212 (יָלַךְ, go); 了 is a Chinese aspect particle with no Hebrew equivalent.
LCC 都 (all/entirely) has no Hebrew correspondent and is left unannotated.

Gen/14.lcc_sn: 有一個逃<WH06412>出來<WH0935><WTH8799>的人告訴<WH05046><WTH8686>希伯來人<WH05680>亞伯蘭<WAH09001><WH087>。亞伯蘭<WAH01931>正在亞摩利人<WH0567>幔利<WH04471>的聖篤耨香樹<WAH09002><WH0436>【1】那裏居住<WH07931><WTH8802>。幔利是以實各<WH0812>的族弟兄<WH0251>，也是亞乃<WH06063>的族弟兄；這些人<WAH01992>都是和亞伯蘭<WH087>結約<WH01285>的盟友<WH01167>。
Gen/14.lcc_original: 有一個逃出來的人告訴希伯來人亞伯蘭。亞伯蘭正在亞摩利人幔利的聖篤耨香樹【1】那裏居住。幔利是以實各的族弟兄，也是亞乃的族弟兄；這些人都是和亞伯蘭結約的盟友。
Gen/14.unv_sn_reference: 有一個逃<WH06412>出來<WH0935><WTH8799>的人告訴<WH05046><WTH8686>希伯來人<WH05680>亞伯蘭<WAH09001><WH087>；亞伯蘭<WAH01931>正住<WH07931><WTH8802>在亞摩利人<WH0567>幔利<WH04471>的橡樹<WAH09002><WH0436>那裡。幔利和以實各<WH0812>並亞乃<WH06063>都是弟兄<WH0251>，曾與<WAH01992>亞伯蘭<WH087>聯盟<WH01167><WH01285>。
notes: LCC renders UNV 橡樹 as 聖篤耨香樹【1】 (different tree identification with footnote marker); SNs WAH09002+WH0436 inserted immediately after the word and before 【1】 to preserve the footnote reference in place
UNV summarises brotherhood as 弟兄<WH0251> once; LCC expands to two occurrences of 族弟兄 (once per sibling pair). WH0251 tagged only on the first occurrence (Eshcol relationship) since UNV uses it once
Hebrew הֵם (WAH01992 = 'and they') surfaces as 曾與 in UNV but is rendered explicitly as 這些人 in LCC; WAH01992 tagged on 這些人
LCC 結約的盟友 expands UNV 聯盟<WH01167><WH01285>: 結約 receives WH01285 (בְּרִית, covenant) and 盟友 receives WH01167 (בַּעַל, lord/partner)
LCC places verb 居住 at end of clause rather than mid-clause (UNV 正住); WH07931+WTH8802 attached to 居住 in LCC accordingly

Gen/14.lcc_original: 亞伯蘭聽見他的姪兒被擄了去，就抽出他家裏生養的精練壯丁三百一十八人，直追到但。
notes: UNV 率領 → LCC 抽出 for <WH07324> (וַיָּרֶק, lit. 'to draw/pour out'); LCC's 抽出 is actually closer to the Hebrew meaning than UNV's 率領 (lead/command)
UNV editorial note 【原文是弟兄<WH0251>】 is a translator's note; LCC directly uses 姪兒 without comment, so <WH0251> attaches to 姪兒 as a normal (non-braced) tag since LCC has an explicit word
{<WAH03588>} (כִּי, 'that') retained as implicit — LCC also omits an explicit conjunction here
{<WAH0853>} (direct object marker אֵת) retained as implicit — no Chinese equivalent in LCC
LCC aspect particle 了 (before 去) left unannotated; LCC adds 的 (他的姪兒) also left unannotated — both are Chinese grammatical additions with no Hebrew counterpart

Gen/14.lcc_original: 他和他的奴僕趁夜分隊，攻擊敵人，擊敗了他們，又追到大馬色北邊的何把；
notes: LCC expands the Hebrew 分隊 + עֲלֵיהֶם (he divided against them) into two clauses: 分隊 (WH02505+WTH8735) and 攻擊敵人 (where WAH05921=עֲלֵיהֶם attaches to 敵人, mirroring UNV's pattern of anchoring WAH05921 to the noun object rather than the Chinese verb).

The single Hebrew verb וַיַּכֵּם (he smote them, WH05221+WTH8686) is rendered in LCC as 擊敗了他們; tags attach to 擊敗 as the closest verbal match. 攻擊 before it is an LCC expansion with no direct Hebrew word and is left unannotated.
LCC renders Damascus as 大馬色 vs UNV 大馬士革; both receive WH01834.
了 (perfective aspect particle after 擊敗) and 他的 (possessive before 奴僕) are left unannotated as Chinese grammatical additions with no direct Hebrew counterparts.

Gen/14.lcc_sn: 將<WAH0853>一切<WAH03605>財物<WH07399>奪回來<WH07725><WTH8686>，也<WAH01571>將<WAH0853>他的姪兒<WH0251>羅得<WH03876>、和羅得的財物<WH07399>、以及<WAH01571><WAH0853>婦女<WH0802>{<WAH0853>}人口<WH05971>、都奪回來。
Gen/14.lcc_original: 將一切財物奪回來，也將他的姪兒羅得、和羅得的財物、以及婦女人口、都奪回來。
Gen/14.unv_sn_reference: 將<WAH0853>被擄掠的一切<WAH03605>財物<WH07399>奪回來<WH07725><WTH8686>，連<WAH01571>{<WAH0853>}他姪兒<WH0251>羅得<WH03876>和他的財物<WH07399>，以及<WAH01571><WAH0853>婦女<WH0802>、{<WAH0853>}人民<WH05971>也都奪回來。
notes: UNV 連<WAH01571>{<WAH0853>} → LCC has explicit 也將, so distributed as 也<WAH01571>將<WAH0853>: 也 carries גַּם and 將 carries the now-explicit accusative את (dropping braces per rule 3).
UNV {<WAH0853>}人民<WH05971>: LCC combines 婦女人口 without separator, so the implicit accusative between them is retained as {<WAH0853>}人口<WH05971>.
LCC uses 人口 (population) where UNV has 人民 — semantically equivalent, mapped to <WH05971> (עָם).
LCC omits UNV's 被擄掠的 (the captured/taken-captive participial modifier); no SNs were attached to that phrase so no impact.
LCC says 羅得的財物 where UNV says 他的財物 — a clarifying paraphrase; still mapped to <WH07399>.

Gen/14.lcc_original: 亞伯蘭擊敗了基大老瑪和跟他同盟的王回來的時候，所多瑪王出來，在沙微山谷，就是王之山谷，迎接亞伯蘭。
notes: WH0310 (אַחַר 'after') kept implicit — LCC expresses the temporal clause via 的時候 with no explicit 'after' word.
SNs for 擊敗 placed before aspect particle 了, which has no Hebrew equivalent and is left unannotated.
Second WAH0853 (direct object marker for the allied kings) was unwrapped in UNV but treated as implicit {<WAH0853>} in LCC since Chinese has no direct object marker particle.
LCC restructures the parenthetical gloss to precede 迎接亞伯蘭 (vs. UNV's end-of-verse placement); SNs distributed to match LCC word order.
LCC writes 山谷 where UNV has 谷; both mapped to WH06010 (עֵמֶק = valley) — 山 is a LCC stylistic addition with no Hebrew equivalent.
迎接他 (UNV) → 迎接亞伯蘭 (LCC explicit referent); WAH09001/WH07125/WTH8800 attached after 亞伯蘭 as the phrase end.

Gen/14.lcc_original: 又有撒冷王麥基洗德、帶着餅和酒也出來：他是至高者上帝的祭司。
notes: LCC uses 至高者 vs UNV's 至高 — both map to H5945 (עֶלְיוֹן, Most High); tag attaches after 至高者
LCC uses 上帝 vs UNV's 神 — both map to H410 (אֵל); WAH09001+WH0410 attach after 上帝的 following the same possessive-particle pattern as UNV's 神的
LCC inserts 也 before 出來 as a stylistic particle — no Hebrew equivalent, left unannotated
UNV's 迎接 (to meet) had no SN in UNV either; LCC omits it entirely — no SN loss
WTH8689 (Hiphil morphology) kept paired with WH03318 on 帶着, matching UNV pattern

Gen/14.lcc_original: 他給亞伯蘭祝福說：『願天地的製作主，至高者上帝，賜福與亞伯蘭！
notes: UNV 祝福 and 說 are annotated separately; LCC writes 祝福說 as a run-on phrase, so tags are attached after each respective character to preserve individual alignment.
UNV 主<WH07069><WTH8802> (Heb. qānāh = possessor/maker, Qal ptcp) is rendered by LCC as 製作主; tag attaches after 製作主 as the whole compound is the translation of that one Hebrew participial form.
UNV 至高<WH05945>的　神<WAH09001><WH0410> maps cleanly to LCC 至高者<WH05945> 上帝<WAH09001><WH0410>; 至高者 absorbs the adjective and the nominalizing 者, while 上帝 is LCC's standard rendering of אֵל (WH0410).

Gen/14.lcc_sn: 至高者<WH05945>上帝<WH0410>{<WAH0834>}把你的敵人<WH06862>交<WH04042><WTH8765>在你手裏<WAH09002><WH03027>，他是應當受祝頌<WH01288><WTH8803>的！』亞伯蘭就把他一切所有的<WAH04480><WAH03605>、拿出十分之一<WH04643>來，給<WH05414><WTH8799>麥基洗德<WAH09001>。
Gen/14.lcc_original: 至高者上帝把你的敵人交在你手裏，他是應當受祝頌的！』亞伯蘭就把他一切所有的、拿出十分之一來，給麥基洗德。
Gen/14.unv_sn_reference: 至高<WH05945>的　神<WH0410>{<WAH0834>}把敵人<WH06862>交<WH04042><WTH8765>在你手裡<WAH09002><WH03027>，是應當稱頌<WH01288><WTH8803>的！」亞伯蘭就把所得的<WAH04480><WAH03605>拿出十分之一<WH04643>來，給<WH05414><WTH8799>麥基洗德<WAH09001>。
notes: WH05945 (עֶלְיוֹן, Most High) attaches to 至高者 — the 者 suffix in LCC is a title nominalizer, not the relative pronoun, so WAH0834 remains implicit: LCC restructures the relative clause 'who delivered' into a new clause beginning with 他, leaving no explicit Chinese word for אֲשֶׁר.
UNV 所得的 (WAH04480 מִן + WAH03605 כֹּל) maps to LCC 一切所有的 — both express 'all that he had'; tags attach after 一切所有的.
UNV 稱頌 → LCC 受祝頌 for WH01288 (בָּרַךְ); morphology WTH8803 (Qal passive participle) follows immediately after.
LCC adds 你的 (before 敵人) and 他 (before 是應當) as natural Chinese pronominal expansions — left unannotated as they have no Hebrew equivalents.

Gen/14.lcc_original: 所多瑪王對亞伯蘭說：『你把人口給我；財物你拿走。』
notes: UNV '你自己<WAH09001>' becomes LCC '你<WAH09001>' — LCC omits the emphatic 自己, so the WAH09001 prefix marker attaches directly to 你
UNV '拿去吧' becomes LCC '拿走' — the directional complement 走 is LCC's own addition with no Hebrew equivalent and is left unannotated; <WH03947><WTH8798> attach to 拿 only
Punctuation differences (「」vs『』, ，vs；, ！vs。) preserved as-is from LCC original
Missing SNs: 07399

Gen/14.lcc_original: 亞伯蘭對所多瑪王說：『我已經向天地的製作主，至高者上帝永恆主舉手起誓；
notes: LCC expands H7069 (qanah = creator/possessor) as 製作主 vs UNV's 主; tags follow 製作主 as the full rendering of that root.
LCC uses 上帝 for H410 (El) where UNV uses 神; straightforward substitution.
LCC renders H3068 (Yahweh) as 永恆主 ('Eternal Lord') rather than 耶和華; tag follows 永恆主.

Hebrew oath idiom 'lift up the hand' (H7311+H3027) is compressed to 起誓 in UNV but made explicit in LCC as 舉手起誓; H7311 (rûm, lift) + WTH8689 + H3027 (yad, hand) all attach to 舉手, while 起誓 is left unannotated as LCC's explicating expansion.

Gen/14.lcc_original: 凡是你的東西就是一根線、一條鞋帶，我也不拿，免得你說：「我使亞伯蘭發財」。
notes: LCC 發財 renders UNV 富足 (<WH06238>+<WTH8689> = הֶעֱשַׁרְתִּי, Hiphil perfect); semantically equivalent.
{<WAH05704>} kept implicit — LCC omits an explicit word for Hebrew וְעַד ('even to/until'); the 、 is punctuation only.
LCC 也 (corresponding to UNV 都) left unannotated — both are Chinese emphasis particles with no direct Hebrew correspondent; negation anchors to 不<WH0518>.
LCC classifier 根→條 for 鞋帶 is a natural Chinese variation; 鞋<WH05275>帶<WH08288> alignment unchanged.
使 tagged <WAH0853> following UNV's convention of mapping the Hebrew direct object marker אֶת onto the causative 使.

Gen/14.lcc_original: 別給我甚麼！只有僮僕們所喫了的，以及和我同行的人、亞乃、以實各、幔利、所應得的分兒、讓他們拿走就是了。』
notes: LCC renders the implicit {<WH01107>} (H1107 בִּלְעָדַי = 'nothing for me/apart from me') explicitly as 別給我甚麼！— braces dropped, SN attached before exclamation mark.
LCC renders the implicit {<WAH07535>} (H7535 רַק = 'only') explicitly as 只有 — braces dropped.
LCC renders the implicit {<WH0582>} (H582 אֱנוֹשׁ = 'men') explicitly as 人 — braces dropped, SN attached after 人.
LCC uses 喫 (traditional character for eating) vs UNV 吃; aspect particle 了 left unannotated per rule 5.
LCC compounds 拿走 ('take away') where UNV has 拿去; <WH03947><WTH8804> attach after 拿 with 走 left unannotated.
Final {<WH02506>} kept implicit: LCC's 就是了 has no explicit word corresponding to the second occurrence of חֶלְקָם (their portion).
LCC connectives 以及 and 讓 carry no Hebrew equivalents and are left unannotated.

Gen/15.lcc_original: 這些事以後、永恆主的話在異象中傳與亞伯蘭，說：『亞伯蘭，你不要怕！我是你的盾牌；你的報賞極大呀。』
notes: 永恆主 (Eternal Lord) assigned WH03068 as LCC's rendering of 耶和華/YHWH (יְהוָה).
UNV's 有<WH01961><WTH8804> (הָיָה, 'came to be') maps to LCC's 傳 ('was transmitted'); the preposition 對<WAH0413> (אֶל, 'to') maps to LCC's 與.

LCC restructures the closing clause from verbal (UNV: 必大大地賞賜你 = 'will greatly reward you') to nominal (LCC: 你的報賞極大呀 = 'your reward is exceedingly great'). SNs redistributed: 你的報賞<WH07939> = שְׂכָרְךָ; 極<WH03966> = מְאֹד; 大<WH07235><WTH8687> = הַרְבֵּה (Hiph. inf.abs. of רָבָה); 呀 is a Chinese exclamatory particle with no Hebrew equivalent, left unannotated.
LCC 這些 ('these things') corresponds to UNV 這<WAH0428>; 這些 receives WAH0428 (אֵלֶּה) and the following 事 separately receives WH01697 (דָּבָר), matching the Hebrew הַדְּבָרִים הָאֵלֶּה.

Exod/1.lcc_sn: 以色列<WH03478>衆兒子<WH01121>、各人<WH0376>帶着<WH0935><WTH8804>家眷<WH01004>和<WAH0854>雅各<WH03290>一同到埃及<WH04714>去<WH0935><WTH8802>：他們的名字<WH08034>記在下面<WAH0428>：
Exod/1.lcc_original: 以色列衆兒子、各人帶着家眷和雅各一同到埃及去：他們的名字記在下面：
notes: LCC splits the motion verb as 到...去 (circumlocution); placed H0935+WTH8802 after 去 which completes the verbal action

Lev/1.lcc_sn: 『人的供物<WH07133>若<WAH0518>是以羊羣<WH06629>中<WAH04480>的爲燔祭<WAH09001><WH05930>，無論是用<WAH04480>綿羊<WH03775>或<WAH0176>{<WAH04480>}山羊<WH05795>，他總要供獻<WH07126><WTH8686>一隻公的<WH02145>、完全沒有殘疾的<WH08549>。
Lev/1.lcc_original: 『人的供物若是以羊羣中的爲燔祭，無論是用綿羊或山羊，他總要供獻一隻公的、完全沒有殘疾的。
notes: UNV has two implicit tags {<WAH04480>}{<WH06629>} between 供物 and 若 (no Chinese words for 'from the flock'). LCC makes both explicit via '羊羣中的': 羊羣<WH06629> covers H6629 (flock) and 中<WAH04480> covers the first מִן (H4480); braces dropped per Rule 3.
LCC's '以' before '羊羣' is a Chinese preposition serving as grammatical glue with no direct Hebrew correspondent; left unannotated.
Second H4480 (UNV: 以<WAH04480> before 綿羊) maps to LCC's '用' in '是用綿羊'. Third H4480 (UNV implicit before 山羊) remains {<WAH04480>} because LCC's '或山羊' has no explicit preposition word for it.

LCC reverses UNV's '沒有殘疾的<WH08549>公羊<WH02145>' order into '公的<WH02145>、完全沒有殘疾的<WH08549>'. This actually matches the Hebrew word order (זָכָר תָּמִים = male first, then perfect); tags applied to their respective LCC words.
LCC additions '無論是', '一隻', '他總要', '完全' (as intensifier before 沒有殘疾的) and '是' (after 若) have no Hebrew equivalents and are left unannotated.

Lev/1.lcc_original: 他要把羊宰在祭壇的北邊、在永恆主面前；亞倫子孫做祭司的要將羊血潑在祭壇的四圍。
notes: 耶和華<WH03068> → 永恆主<WH03068>: LCC uses 永恆主 for Yahweh; SN attached to the full divine name phrase
壇<WH04196> → 祭壇<WH04196>: LCC uses the fuller term 祭壇; SN attached to the full word
於<WAH05921> → 在<WAH05921>: LCC uses 在 for the preposition; SN attached to 在 in both occurrences
灑<WH02236><WTH8804> → 潑<WH02236><WTH8804>: different verb for sprinkling/dashing; both tags follow 潑
周圍<WH05439> → 四圍<WH05439>: LCC uses 四圍 for 'all around'; SN attached to 四圍
Second <WAH0853>: placed after 將 (LCC's object marker), mirroring UNV's 把<WAH0853> structure — 將 serves same grammatical role as 把 here
他 at start of LCC clause has no SN; it is a translator-added pronoun clarifying the subject with no Hebrew counterpart

Lev/1.lcc_original: 那人要把燔祭牲切成塊子；祭司就把切塊、連頭和板油、都擺在祭壇上之火的柴上；
notes: LCC restructures the verse into two cleaner clauses: (1) the offerer cuts the animal, (2) the priest arranges everything. The 連頭和板油 phrase migrates from UNV's first clause into LCC's second clause; SNs follow the words to their new positions.
UNV's implicit {<WAH0853>} (direct object marker אֶת, backreferencing the pieces) maps to LCC's explicit 切塊 in the second clause — braces dropped per rule 3.
Both implicit {<WAH0834>} markers (relative pronoun אֲשֶׁר) map to explicit Chinese relative/possessive particles in LCC: 之 and 的 respectively — braces dropped per rule 3.
LCC 板油 corresponds to UNV 脂油 (both translate חֵלֶב WH06309); SNs transferred to 板油.
LCC adds 那人 as an explicit subject and 都 as an emphatic adverb — neither has a Hebrew counterpart, left unannotated.

Lev/1.lcc_original: 至於臟腑和腿、那人卻要用水去洗。祭司就要把這一切全都燻在祭壇上：這是燔祭、是怡神的香氣之火祭獻與永恆主。
notes: 那人 (implied subject in LCC) has no corresponding SN in UNV and is left unannotated.
{<WAH0853>} is implicit in UNV (Hebrew את marker); LCC has explicit 把 as direct object marker, so braces are dropped and tag attaches to 把.
UNV uses two verbs 奉獻<WH07126><WTH8689> and 燒<WH06999><WTH8689>; LCC condenses both into the single verb 燻, so both SN sets are attached there.
WAH09002 (ב inseparable prefix on מַיִם) is attached to 用 rather than 水 because LCC uses 用 as an explicit instrumental preposition, with WH04325 then attaching to 水.
WH05207 (ניחוח, pleasing/soothing) → 怡神的; WH07381 (ריח, scent/aroma) → 香氣; order follows LCC word order, not UNV.
LCC's 獻與 has no dedicated SN; the ל prepositional prefix is captured by WAH09001 on 永恆主.
LCC additions with no Hebrew equivalent (去, 之, 這一切, 那人) are left unannotated.

Lev/1.lcc_original: 『人獻給永恆主的供物若是以禽鳥中的爲燔祭，他就要從斑鳩或雛鴿中帶着【2】他的供物來獻上。
notes: 永恆主 = LCC's rendering of יהוה; WAH09001 (ל prefix) and WH03068 both attached to it, following UNV's pattern of tagging 耶和華 as a unit with its prefix
UNV's {<WAH04480>} before 斑鳩 was implicit (braced); LCC has explicit 從 for מִן, so braces dropped and WAH04480 placed on 從
The second (unbraced) WAH04480 between 或是 and 雛 in UNV is orphaned (no preceding Chinese character in UNV); placed on LCC's 中 which closes the 從…中 frame covering 雛鴿 — this is the weakest alignment
WH07126+WTH8689 placed on 獻上: LCC rephrases 就要獻 as the circumlocution 帶着…來獻上; 帶着 left unannotated as LCC elaboration with no direct Hebrew equivalent
WAH0853 (אֵת direct-object marker) has no corresponding 為 in LCC; attached to 供物 in 他的供物 as the nearest host word
LCC's 以禽鳥中的 renders מִן-הָעוֹף: WAH04480 placed on 以 (preposition, matching UNV's 以<WAH04480>), WH05775 on 禽鳥, 中的 left unannotated as LCC's stylistic addition

Lev/1.lcc_original: 祭司要把禽鳥帶【2】到祭壇前，揪下牠的頭來，將鳥燻在祭壇上；牠的血要讓流在祭壇邊。
notes: UNV 拿 (WH07126) → LCC 帶; both mean 'to bring/take'; SN placed before footnote marker 【2】
UNV 燒 (WH06999) → LCC 燻; both from Hebrew קטר (to make smoke / burn offering); semantically equivalent
LCC inserts 讓 (let/allow) before 流 as a causative periphrasis not present in Hebrew; 讓 left unannotated, WH04680+WTH8738 attached to 流
{<WAH0853>} (Hebrew accusative marker את) kept implicit — LCC has 牠的 as a possessive pronoun, not the accusative particle itself
UNV 壇 (×3, WH04196) becomes LCC 祭壇 throughout; WH04196 attached to 祭壇 in all three occurrences
UNV 壇的旁邊: WH04196 on 壇, WH07023 on 旁邊 → LCC 祭壇邊: WH04196 on 祭壇, WH07023 on 邊

Lev/1.lcc_original: 那人要把禽鳥的嗉子和翎毛除掉，丟在祭壇附近東邊、倒灰的地方。
notes: LCC uses 翎毛 as its main text where UNV has 髒物 with 翎毛 as a parenthetical alternate; transferred <WAH09002><WH05133> directly to 翎毛 since LCC makes the implicit explicit.
LCC reorders the locative phrase: UNV has 東(H6924)邊(H681) but LCC writes 附近(near)東邊(east-side); H681 (אֵצֶל = beside/near) maps to 附近 and H6924 (קֶדֶם = east) maps to 東邊.
{<WAH0853>} kept implicit between 丟 and 在 — LCC also has no explicit object marker there.
把 receives <WAH0853> as the Chinese object-marker particle directly corresponds to Hebrew אֵת (H853).

Lev/1.lcc_sn: 他要在翅膀<WAH09002><WH03671>那裏把禽鳥<WAH0853>撕裂<WH08156><WTH8765>，可不<WAH03808>要完全分開<WH0914><WTH8686>。祭司<WH03548>就要把鳥<WAH0853>燻在<WAH05921>祭壇<WH04196>上，{<WAH0834>}在<WAH05921>壇火<WH0784>上面的柴<WH06086>上燻<WH06999><WTH8689>：這是<WH01931>燔祭<WH05930>，是怡神香氣<WH07381><WH05207>之火祭<WH0801>、獻與永恆主<WAH09001><WH03068>。
Lev/1.lcc_original: 他要在翅膀那裏把禽鳥撕裂，可不要完全分開。祭司就要把鳥燻在祭壇上，在壇火上面的柴上燻：這是燔祭，是怡神香氣之火祭、獻與永恆主。
notes: WAH0853 appears twice: 禽鳥 is the explicit object of 撕裂 (matching UNV 把鳥<WAH0853>撕開), and 鳥 in 把鳥燻 is LCC's explicit rendering of UNV's implicit {<WAH0853>} — braces dropped per Rule 3
LCC uses resumptive-verb structure (把鳥燻...在壇火上面的柴上燻); WH06999+WTH8689 assigned to the second 燻, which closes the two locative phrases and matches UNV's 在壇上、在火的柴上焚燒 structure
怡神香氣 covers two Hebrew words: WH07381 (רֵיחַ = aroma) + WH05207 (נִיחֹחַ = pleasing); both SNs attached to the compound phrase per Rule 6
LCC 壇火 renders UNV 火 (WH0784); 壇 is LCC's clarifying addition and left unannotated
LCC 那裏 (at that location, after 翅膀) has no direct Hebrew equivalent; left unannotated
{<WAH0834>} (אֲשֶׁר, relative particle) placed between the two locative phrases as in UNV; no explicit relative word in LCC either so braces retained
永恆主 (Eternal Lord) is Lü's rendering of יְהוָה (WH03068); WAH09001 (לְ prefix) attaches to the same phrase

Lev/2.lcc_original: 『若有人以素祭爲供物獻與永恆主，他的供物應該是細麵；他要澆上油，加上乳香，
notes: 素祭 consolidates two adjacent UNV tokens (素<WH04503> + 祭<WH07133>) into one LCC compound; both SNs attached together since LCC treats 素祭 as a single lexical unit
以 (Chinese instrumental particle in the literary 以…獻與 construction) left unannotated — it has no direct Hebrew word equivalent; it is a Chinese syntactic device reordering the object before the verb
永恆主 (LCC's rendering of יְהוָה) receives <WAH09001><WH03068>; <WAH09001> reflects the lamed prefix in לַיהוָה

LCC's 他的供物應該是 makes explicit the implicit copular clause in UNV's 要<WAH01961><WTH8799>; H1961 attached to the verbal head 應該是; 他的供物 (= קָרְבָּנוֹ possessive suffix) left unannotated, mirroring UNV which does not re-annotate it
H7133 appears twice (on 素祭 and 爲供物) faithfully following UNV's dual-annotation pattern (祭<WH07133>為供物<WH07133>), reflecting the construct phrase קָרְבַּן מִנְחָה

Lev/2.lcc_original: 帶到亞倫子孫做祭司的那裏。祭司要從細麵中取出一把來，也取它的一些油、連它所有的乳香，都燻在祭壇上做它的表樣、做怡神香氣之火祭獻與永恆主。
notes: WAH04480 (מִן prefix) on 細麵: split across 從<WAH04480>細麵<WH05560> since LCC uses explicit 從 to translate the prefix, whereas UNV attaches both tags to 細麵 alone; the remaining two WAH04480 instances (on 出 and 油) have no explicit prefix word in LCC and stay attached to their content word
WAH0853 (direct object marker אֵת): kept as {<WAH0853>} implicit — in UNV it attaches to explicit 把, but LCC uses no 把 construction; no other word in LCC serves as a direct object marker here
WH0234 (אַזְכָּרָה, memorial portion): UNV 作為紀念 → LCC 做它的表樣 ('as its exemplar/token'); tag attached to 表樣
WH07381+WH05207 (rêaḥ nîḥôaḥ, pleasing aroma): UNV 馨香 → LCC 怡神香氣 ('spirit-soothing aroma'); both tags attached after 怡神香氣
WAH09001+WH03068 (YHWH): UNV 耶和華 → LCC 永恆主 ('Eternal Lord'); clause order differs — LCC moves 獻與永恆主 to the very end, after 火祭, so both tags follow 永恆主

Lev/2.lcc_sn: 素祭<WAH04480><WH04503>中的餘留部分<WH03498><WTH8737>要歸於亞倫<WAH09001><WH0175>和他的子孫<WAH09001><WH01121>：這是獻與永恆主<WH03068>的火祭<WAH04480><WH0801>中之至聖<WH06944><WH06944>的。
Lev/2.lcc_original: 素祭中的餘留部分要歸於亞倫和他的子孫：這是獻與永恆主的火祭中之至聖的。
Lev/2.unv_sn_reference: 素祭<WAH04480><WH04503>所剩的<WH03498><WTH8737>要歸給亞倫<WAH09001><WH0175>和他的子孫<WAH09001><WH01121>；這是獻與耶和華<WH03068>的火祭<WAH04480><WH0801>中為至<WH06944>聖<WH06944>的。
notes: WAH04480+WH04503 placed after 素祭; LCC inserts 中的 before 餘留部分 as a structural rephrasing particle — left unannotated
LCC 餘留部分 ('remainder portion') corresponds to UNV 所剩的 (H03498 + WTH8737 Niphal ptcp)
LCC 永恆主 is the rendering of YHWH (耶和華 H03068)
Hebrew קֹדֶשׁ קָדָשִׁים (most holy) — UNV splits two H06944 tags across 至 and 聖; LCC writes 至聖 as a unit, so both H06944 tags are consolidated after 至聖

Lev/2.lcc_original: 『若獻手提爐子裏烤的素祭爲供物，你就要用無酵的細麵將油調和的哈拉餅，或是抹上油的無酵薄餅。
notes: WH03989 (מַאֲפֶה = baked thing): UNV uses explicit noun 物, LCC folds the concept into the adjective 烤的 modifying 素祭; attached WH03989 to 烤的.
LCC adds 手提 (hand-carried/portable) before 爐子 with no Hebrew equivalent; WH08574 attaches to 爐子 only.
LCC 哈拉餅 is a phonetic transliteration of חַלָּה (WH02471), which UNV renders as generic 餅; WH02471 attached to the full 哈拉餅.
UNV 調 becomes LCC 調和 (both = בָּלַל WH01101); SN and morphology WTH8803 attach after 調和.
LCC 抹上 adds directional complement 上 with no SN; WH04886+WTH8803 attach after the full verb phrase 抹上.
LCC 你 (implied subject from Hebrew verb conjugation) has no SN.

Lev/2.lcc_original: 你的供物若是在煎盤上作的素祭，那就該是用油調和的無酵細麵。
notes: LCC 供物 is the direct rendering of H07133 (קָרְבָּן); UNV paraphrases it as 做的物, but the referent is the same word.
LCC 若是 takes WAH0518 (וְאִם) on 若; the copula 是 is LCC's own addition with no separate SN.
LCC inverts the oil-and-mixing order relative to UNV: UNV has 調…油 while LCC has 用油調和; WAH09002+WH08081 attach to 油 and WH01101+WTH8803 attach to 調和.
LCC 該是 receives WAH01961+WTH8799 (הָיָה Qal imperfect); LCC's 那就 is a discourse connector with no Hebrew equivalent.
你的 (possessive pronoun) has no explicit SN because the Hebrew possessive suffix on קָרְבָּן is not separately tagged in UNV either.

Lev/2.lcc_original: 你要把它擘成塊子，澆上油：這是素祭。
notes: 你要把 (imperative/causative construction) has no direct Hebrew equivalent in the UNV annotation and is left unannotated
LCC 它 (explicit pronoun) is the explicit realization of UNV {<WAH0853>} (implicit object marker את with pronominal suffix); braces dropped per Rule 3 and tag attached to 它
UNV 分成 → LCC 擘成: different Chinese verbs for the same Hebrew פתת (H6626, break into pieces); morphology <WTH8800> co-attached to 擘成

Lev/2.lcc_sn: 你的供物<WH07133>若是<WAH0518>淺鍋裏煮的<WH04802>素祭<WH04503>，那就該是細麵<WH05560>合油<WAH09002><WH08081>作的<WH06213><WTH8735>。
Lev/2.lcc_original: 你的供物若是淺鍋裏煮的素祭，那就該是細麵合油作的。
notes: LCC's 淺鍋裏煮的 (cooked in a shallow pan) renders UNV's 煎盤 — both map to מַחֲבַת (04802); tagged as a single phrase.
LCC's 你的 is the possessive suffix of קָרְבָּנְךָ; left unannotated as a pronoun, with WH07133 placed after 供物.
LCC's transitional phrase 那就該是 has no direct Hebrew equivalent and is left unannotated.
Prefix tag WAH09002 (בְּ, 'with') and oil tag WH08081 (שֶׁמֶן) are both attached to LCC's 合油, which fuses the preposition (合) and noun (油) into one unit.

Lev/2.lcc_original: 你要將這些東西作的素祭帶到永恆主面前，交【1】給祭司，讓他拿到祭壇前。
notes: 把→將 for H853 (direct object marker): LCC uses 將 as the object-introducing preposition, functionally identical to UNV's 把.
H834 (אשר, relative pronoun): was implicit {<WAH0834>} in UNV with no explicit Chinese word; LCC has explicit relative particle 的 in 作的, so per Rule 3 braces are dropped and attached as 的<WAH0834>.
H6213+morphology attaches to 作 (the explicit verb), H834 attaches to 的 (the relative particle), matching Hebrew word order אשר עשה.
耶和華→永恆主 (Yahweh→Eternal Lord in LCC): both SNs <WAH09001><WH03068> attach after 永恆主.
並奉→交 for H7126 (קרב, bring near/present): LCC drops the conjunction 並 and uses 交 as the main verb; SNs attach after 交, with footnote marker 【1】 preserved in its original inter-word position.
帶→拿 for H5066 (נגש, draw near/bring): the main verb within LCC's auxiliary phrase 讓他拿; 讓他 are LCC expansions with no Hebrew SN equivalent.
壇→祭壇: LCC uses the full compound term 祭壇 (altar) where UNV abbreviates to 壇; H4196 attaches after 祭壇.
LCC's explicit subject 你 has no SN — implicit in the Hebrew imperative verb form.

Lev/4.lcc_original: 祭司要把點兒血抹在會棚內永恆主面前香壇的四角上，又把公牛所有的血都倒在會棚的出入處燔祭壇腳那裏。
notes: Rule 3 applied: {<WH03548>} was implicit in UNV (no explicit subject); LCC has explicit 祭司 → 祭司<WH03548>
WAH04480 (partitive מִן, 'some/from') mapped to LCC's 點兒 (≈ UNV's 些, both mean 'a little/some')
棚 (LCC) vs 幕 (UNV): both = אֹהֶל (WH0168); WAH09002 (inseparable ב prefix, 'in') assigned to 內, giving 棚<WH0168>內<WAH09002>
永恆主<WH03068>: LCC renders יהוה as 永恆主 rather than UNV's 耶和華; same SN WH03068 assigned
出入處<WH06607>: LCC uses 出入處 ('entrance/exit passage') for UNV's 門口 ('doorway'); both = פֶּתַח (WH06607)
都 (between 血 and 倒 in LCC) left unannotated — Chinese aspectual intensifier reinforcing 所有的; no independent Hebrew SN counterpart
Both {<WAH0834>} implicit relative markers (אֲשֶׁר) retained: LCC likewise omits explicit relative pronoun in both positions

Lev/4.lcc_original: 他要把解罪祭的公牛一切脂肪都取起來；就是把蓋臟腑上的脂肪和臟腑上的一切脂肪、
notes: UNV's implicit {WH07311}/{WTH8686} (lift/take away) has an explicit realization in LCC as 取起來; Rule 3 applied, morphology WTH8686 co-attached to same word.
{WAH04480} (מִן 'from it') has no explicit LCC word; placed as implicit marker after 取起來 since the directional sense is absorbed into the verb phrase.
UNV's implicit {WAH05921} (עַל 'upon') between 蓋 and 臟 is realized as explicit 上 in LCC's 臟腑上; Rule 3 applied — braces dropped, tag attached to 上.
UNV's implicit {WAH0853} in 的{WAH0853}脂油 (first clause's appositive DO marker) is realized as explicit 把 in LCC's second-clause 就是把; Rule 3 applied.
Third occurrence of WAH0853 (臟腑上 before 一切) remains implicit {WAH0853} — no explicit 把 or coverb in LCC at that position.
LCC uses 臟腑 (viscera/entrails) where UNV has 臟; both map to WH07130 (קֶרֶב).

Lev/4.lcc_original: 兩個腰子、和腰子上的脂肪、靠近腰兩旁的脂肪、和肝上的附屬物、連腰子、都取下來，
notes: UNV 並 (WAH0853, waw + direct object marker אֵת) has no explicit LCC equivalent; kept as implicit {<WAH0853>} before 兩個.
LCC 靠近 is a single two-character compound that covers both UNV 就是<WAH0834> (H834, relative pronoun אֲשֶׁר) and 靠<WAH05921> (H5921, upon/near); both SNs attached to 靠近.
LCC 附屬物 ('appendage') corresponds to UNV 網子 ('caul/network', H3508); different renderings of the same Hebrew term for the lobe of the liver.
LCC 連 ('along with/including') is an explicit word for the implicit Hebrew preposition {<WAH05921>} from UNV; braces dropped per Rule 3 and SN attached directly to 連.
The second 的脂肪 (in 靠近腰兩旁的脂肪) is not re-tagged with H2459, consistent with UNV where the 就是 appositive clause also carries no separate fat SN.

Lev/4.lcc_original: （正如從平安祭的牛取起來一樣）；祭司要把這些祭品燻在燔祭壇上。
notes: LCC 正如...一樣 renders כַּאֲשֶׁר as a discontinuous frame; WAH09003+WAH0834 attached to 正如 since it is the head of the comparison clause opener
LCC separates מִן (WAH04480) into standalone 從 rather than fusing it onto the noun; WAH04480→從, WH07794→牛

直站着 inverts UNV's 站定 order: WH03559 (הָכֵן, firmly) assigned to adverb 直, WH05975 (עָמַד, stood) to 站, due to Chinese adverb-before-verb grammar. Hebrew and UNV both have H5975 before H3559, but LCC's 直 modifies 站 as a preposed adverb.
等 (while/as) is LCC's free connective addition with no Hebrew SN equivalent — left unannotated.

全<WAH03605>國的人<WH01471>: 全 renders כָּל (H3605, 'all/whole') and 國的人 renders גּוֹי (H1471, 'nation'); UNV maps 都→WAH03605 after 盡, but in LCC 全 is the semantically primary carrier of כָּל, while the following 都 is a Chinese grammar particle reinforcing 盡 — left unannotated.
爲止 at end of verse is LCC's stylistic terminal phrase with no Hebrew equivalent — unannotated.
{<WAH0834>} (אֲשֶׁר, relative particle) and {<WAH0853>} (אֶת, direct object marker) kept implicit — LCC has no explicit words for either particle.

Josh/4.lcc_original: 全國的人盡都過了約但河，永恆主對約書亞說：
notes: H3605 (WAH03605, כל = all) reassigned from UNV's 都 to LCC's 全, which carries the 'all/entire' meaning in 全國的人; UNV's 都 is a generic adverb but LCC's 全 is the true semantic anchor for 'all'
LCC's 都 in 盡都 left unannotated — H3605 already placed on 全; 都 here is part of the 盡都 compound adverb and is stylistic
H1471 (גּוֹי, nation/people) attached to 人 as the nominal head of 全國的人; LCC expands UNV's 國民 into 全國的人 (all-nation-DE-people)
永恆主 (Eternal Lord) maps to H3068 (Yahweh), same as UNV's 耶和華 — standard LCC rendering of the divine name
LCC omits UNV's 就 (transitional particle); 對 alone carries WAH0413 (אֶל = to/toward)

Josh/4.lcc_original: 『你們要從人民中取十二個人，各族派一人各族派一人。
notes: LCC 你們 (2nd pl.) vs UNV 你 (sg. command form); WAH09001 attached to 你們 as the closest equivalent for the benefactive/dative marker לָכֶם
LCC 人民 (two-char compound) covers UNV 民<WH05971>; WH05971 attached to the full compound 人民
LCC 取 = UNV 揀選; WH03947+WTH8798 both attached to 取

LCC renders the Hebrew distributive (אִישׁ-אֶחָד אִישׁ-אֶחָד) explicitly as 各族派一人各族派一人; the second 各族派 has no Hebrew SN backing (לַשָּׁבֶט appears only once in Hebrew and in UNV), so it is left unannotated; the second 一人 receives WH0259+WH0376 per Rule 3 — LCC has explicit words for the UNV implicit markers {<WH0259>}{<WH0376>}

Josh/4.lcc_original: 要吩咐他們說：「你們要從這裏、從約但河中間、祭司們的腳站着的地方、拿起十二塊石頭來，帶過去，放在你們今夜要住宿的地方。』
notes: Initial 要 (modal verb before 吩咐) left unannotated — Chinese modal with no Hebrew equivalent
Second 要 (before 從這裏) left unannotated — same reason
LCC 拿起 maps to UNV 取 (WH05375+WTH8798) as semantic equivalents (lift/take)
LCC 帶 receives WAH05973 with braces dropped per Rule 3: UNV has implicit {<WAH05973>} but LCC has explicit 帶 covering the same 'carry along' concept
LCC 來 after 石頭 left unannotated — Chinese resultative/aspect particle with no Hebrew equivalent
LCC 站着 maps to UNV 站定 (WH03559+WTH8687) — lexical variant, same root meaning (stand firm/standing)
LCC 祭司們 receives WH03548 — plural 們 does not affect SN assignment
Both implicit {<WAH0853>} markers retained after 過去 and 放 — LCC has no explicit accusative particles

Josh/4.lcc_original: 於是約書亞將他從以色列人中所豫備的那十二個人、各族派一人、各族派一人、都召了來。

Judg/1.lcc_original: 約書亞死了以後，以色列人求問永恆主說：『誰要爲我們先上去攻擊迦南人，和他們交戰呢？』
notes: LCC uses 永恆主 (Lü's distinctive rendering of YHWH) in place of UNV's 耶和華 — SN tags <WAH09002><WH03068> attached to 永恆主.
{<WAH01961>} (wayehi) kept implicit in braces — LCC has no explicit 'and it came to pass'; the clause begins directly with 約書亞.
死了: Hebrew H04194 (מֹות, death/die) attaches to 死; the aspect particle 了 is a Chinese addition with no Hebrew equivalent, left unannotated.

Question clause reordering: UNV has 我們中間<WAH09001>誰<WAH04310>...首先<WAH09002><WH08462>上去; LCC restructures as 誰<WAH04310>要爲我們<WAH09001>先<WAH09002><WH08462>上去. WAH09001 (לָּנוּ, for us) follows 爲我們; WAH09002+WH08462 (בַּתְּחִלָּה, at the first) follow 先.
要 (Chinese modal verb) and 呢 (question-final particle) have no Hebrew equivalents and are left unannotated.

Judg/1.lcc_original: 永恆主說：『猶大要上去；看吧，我已把那地交在他手中了。』
notes: 耶和華→永恆主: both render H03068 (Yahweh); SN attaches to 永恆主
{<WAH02009>} is implicit in UNV but LCC has explicit 看吧 (הנה/behold), so braces dropped and tag attached directly: 看吧<WAH02009>
{<WAH0853>} is implicit in UNV (direct-object marker את) but LCC uses explicit 把 for the same grammatical role, so braces dropped: 把<WAH0853>
UNV 當先上去 vs LCC 要上去: 當先/要 are modal auxiliaries; H05927 (עלה, go up) and morphology tag attach after the main verb 上去
了 at end of sentence is a Chinese aspect particle with no Hebrew equivalent — left unannotated per rule 5

Judg/1.lcc_sn: 猶大<WH03063>對他哥哥<WH0251>西緬<WAH09001><WH08095>說<WH0559><WTH8799>：『請同我<WAH0854>上去<WH05927><WTH8798>、到我拈鬮可得的地<WAH09002><WH01486>去，我們好和迦南人<WAH09002><WH03669>交戰<WH03898><WTH8735>；以後我<WAH0589>也<WAH01571>可以同你<WAH0854>到<WH01980><WTH8804>你拈鬮可得的地<WAH09002><WH01486>去』；於是西緬<WH08095>和他<WAH0854>同去<WH03212><WTH8799>。
Judg/1.lcc_original: 猶大對他哥哥西緬說：『請同我上去、到我拈鬮可得的地去，我們好和迦南人交戰；以後我也可以同你到你拈鬮可得的地去』；於是西緬和他同去。
notes: UNV 到<WH05927><WTH8798>...去 (compound motion) maps to LCC 上去 — tag placed on 上去 since it directly expresses H05927 (עָלָה, go up); the following 到...去 destination phrase is retained as structural.
WH01980<WTH8804> placed on 到 in second directional phrase (以後...到你拈鬮可得的地去), following UNV's attachment pattern of tagging the lead motion word.
LCC adds 可以 (modal 'may/can') after 也 in the second clause — no Hebrew equivalent, left unannotated.
LCC adds 我們 before 好 in the battle clause — no Hebrew equivalent, left unannotated.
Trailing 去 in both directional phrases left unannotated; the verb SN is carried by 上去 and 到 respectively.

Judg/1.lcc_original: 猶大就上去；永恆主把迦南人和比利洗人交在他們手中；他們在比色擊敗了一萬人。
notes: 耶和華<WH03068> → 永恆主 (LCC's rendering of יהוה)
將<WAH0853> → 把 (both are accusative/disposal markers for Hebrew direct object marker אֵת)
擊殺了<WH05221> → 擊敗了 (same root נָכָה, LCC chooses softer rendering)
UNV clause boundary 。→ ；in LCC (preserved LCC punctuation exactly)
和 between 迦南人 and 比利洗人 is unannotated in both versions (Hebrew vav waw is absorbed into the SN sequence)

Judg/1.lcc_original: 他們在比色遇見了亞多尼比色【1】，和他交戰，擊敗了迦南人和比利洗人。
notes: UNV renders Bezek implicitly as 那裡 with both {<WAH09002>} and {<WH0966>} in braces; LCC explicitly names 在比色, so both become explicit: 在<WAH09002>比色<WH0966>.
{<WAH0853>} (direct object marker את) kept implicit in LCC for both occurrences — Chinese does not lexicalize the direct object marker, so there is no explicit LCC word to attach it to as a main SN.
Footnote marker 【1】 preserved in place after SN tags for 亞多尼比色.
LCC 他們 (subject) carries no SN because UNV also has no subject token tagged — the subject is grammatically implicit in the Hebrew verb.
Aspect particles 了 (×2) left unannotated per Rule 5.
WAH09002 on 他 in 和他<WAH09002>: represents the ב prefix of the Hebrew bô (with him); attached to 他 following the UNV placement pattern 與他<WAH09002>爭戰.

Judg/1.lcc_original: 亞多尼比色逃跑；他們追趕他，把他抓住，砍斷他手腳的大姆指。
notes: LCC restructures the pursuit clause: UNV has 追趕，拿住他 (chase, seize-him), LCC has 追趕他，把他抓住 (chase-him, seize-him). The 他 after 追趕 in LCC is LCC's own clarifying addition with no Hebrew correspondent — left unannotated. WAH0853 is assigned to 他 in 把他，as that 他 is the direct object of 抓住, matching UNV's 拿住他<WAH0853>.
The second {<WAH0853>} (direct object marker before 他手腳 in Hebrew) is kept implicit: the 他 in LCC's 他手腳 is a possessive pronoun, not a rendering of the object marker את.
LCC spells 大姆指 (vs UNV 大拇指) — variant orthography for the same word; WH0931 applied normally.

Judg/1.lcc_sn: 亞多尼比色<WH0137>說<WH0559><WTH8799>：『從前有<WAH01961>七十個<WH07657>王<WH04428>、手<WH03027>腳<WH07272>的大姆指<WH0931>都被我砍斷<WH07112><WTH8794>、常在我桌子<WH07979>底下<WAH08478>撿<WH03950><WTH8764>食物；我怎樣<WAH09003><WAH0834>行<WH06213><WTH8804>，上帝<WH0430>怎樣<WAH03651>報應<WH07999><WTH8765>我了<WAH09001>。』他們將亞多尼比色帶到<WH0935><WTH8686>耶路撒冷<WH03389>；他就死在<WH04191><WTH8799>那裏<WAH08033>。
Judg/1.lcc_original: 亞多尼比色說：『從前有七十個王、手腳的大姆指都被我砍斷、常在我桌子底下撿食物；我怎樣行，上帝怎樣報應我了。』他們將亞多尼比色帶到耶路撒冷；他就死在那裏。

notes: UNV '神' → LCC '上帝': standard systematic difference for H0430

כַּאֲשֶׁר…כֵּן 'just as…so' construction rendered differently: UNV '現在…按著我所行的' vs LCC '我怎樣行，…怎樣' — WAH09003+WAH0834 attached to first 怎樣 (representing the 'as/how I' clause head), WAH03651 attached to second 怎樣 (representing 'so/thus')
LCC '撿食物' condenses UNV '拾取零碎食物' — WH03950+WTH8764 attached to 撿; 零碎 was untagged in UNV so no SN loss
LCC adds 常 (aspectual adverb) before 在我桌子底下 with no Hebrew equivalent — left unannotated
UNV transition 於是 is absent in LCC — no SN was attached to it in UNV so no loss

Judg/1.lcc_original: 猶大人攻打了耶路撒冷，將城攻取，用刀擊殺了城裏的人，放火燒城。
notes: UNV 並且<WAH0854> has no equivalent word in LCC (comma serves as the conjunction); WAH0854 (ו prefix on שלח) is attached to 放 since in Hebrew the ו prefix is on the same verb (שלח = H7971) rather than a separate conjunction word
LCC 擊殺 covers UNV 殺 — both correspond to H5221 (נכה, to strike/smite); 擊 adds the striking nuance already present in H5221
UNV {<WAH0853>} before 城 was an implicit direct-object marker; LCC has explicit 城 so braces are dropped and WAH0853 is attached to 城 per Rule 3
LCC aspectual 了 particles (after 攻打 and 擊殺) are left unannotated as Chinese grammar particles with no Hebrew equivalent per Rule 5

Judg/1.lcc_original: 後來猶大人下去，和住山地南地和低原的迦南人交戰。
notes: UNV 高原 → LCC 低原: both render H08219 (שְׁפֵלָה, the Shephelah/lowland). Different lexical choices for the same referent; SN attached to 低原.
UNV 爭戰 → LCC 交戰: synonymous verbs covering H03898 + morphology WTH8736; all three tags attached to 交戰.
Conjunction restructuring: UNV uses 與…和 around 住; LCC uses a single 和 before 住 — no SN loss, 住 still takes H03427+WTH8802 cleanly.

Judg/1.lcc_original: 猶大人去攻擊住希伯崙的迦南人，擊殺了示篩、亞希幔、撻買；希伯崙從前名叫基列亞巴。

The implicit direct object marker {<WAH0853>} before each proper name is kept implicit — LCC has no explicit word for אֵת, and 了 is an aspect particle with a different function.
LCC writes 基列亞巴 without the middle dot used in UNV 基列‧亞巴; WH07153 attaches to the same toponym unchanged.
LCC uses ；as the clause boundary before the Hebron parenthetical rather than UNV's full stop 。; punctuation preserved exactly as in LCC original.

Judg/1.lcc_original: 他們從那裏去攻擊底璧的居民；底璧從前名叫基列西弗。

LCC writes 基列西弗 without the middle dot separator used in UNV (基列‧西弗); H7158 attaches to the full place name as one unit.
H413 (WAH0413) is a preposition meaning 'unto/against'; both UNV and LCC render it as 攻擊, so the tag attaches there directly.

Judg/1.lcc_original: 迦勒說：『誰能攻擊基列西弗，將城攻取，我就把我女兒押撒給他爲妻。』

UNV 基列‧西弗 (with middle dot) → LCC 基列西弗 (no dot); SN <WH07158> attached to full place name as one unit

Dual <WAH09001> prefix markers preserved: first on 他 (lamed = 'to him'), second on 爲妻 (lamed = 'as/for wife')

notes: H01961 ({<WAH01961>}) kept implicit — LCC has no explicit 'it came to pass' / wayehi just as UNV does
勸 (UNV) → 慫恿 (LCC): H5496+TH8686 transferred to 慫恿, same semantic domain (urge/incite/entice)

UNV 。 between clauses → LCC ；: punctuation difference preserved as-is, no SN impact

Judg/1.lcc_original: 她說：『請將一件祝福禮給我；你旣給我住南地，求你也給我一塊有水的盆地。』迦勒就把上盆地和下盆地都給了她。

H3051 (יָהַב, give) assigned to 給 in LCC's split-verb construction 請將…給我; 請將 is treated as syntactic framing with no SN, since 給 carries the core 'give' semantics.
LCC adds 住 after 給我 to render the sense of 'placed me to dwell in' (UNV: 安置在); 住 left unannotated as a LCC interpretive addition.

{<WAH0853>} implicit accusative markers retained at both object positions (before 上盆地 and after 和), corresponding to Hebrew אֵת + וְאֵת; 把 is a Chinese grammatical particle and does not absorb the implicit marker.
LCC's connective 和 (and) and intensifier 都 (both) left unannotated; 了 (perfective aspect particle) likewise unannotated — all are Chinese-only additions.

Judg/1.lcc_original: 摩西的岳父是基尼人，他的子孫和猶大人一同離開了棕樹城，上亞拉得那裏的南地猶大的曠野去，和族民同住。
notes: UNV parenthetical 內兄（或譯：岳父<WH02859><WTH8802>）collapsed to LCC 岳父; per Rule 3 braces dropped and SNs attached directly to 岳父.
LCC 那裏的 functions as a relative clause particle corresponding to UNV 的<WAH0834> (Hebrew אֲשֶׁר); WAH0834 attached to the full 那裏的 token.
LCC 南地 renders UNV 以南 (Negev prefix+root); WAH09002+WH05045 both attached to 南地 as a compound.

LCC final clause 和族民同住 restructures UNV 住在民中: 和<WH0854> covers UNV 在 (Hebrew אֶת = with), 族民<WH05971> covers 民 (LCC adds 族 for clan nuance but no additional Hebrew lemma), 同住<WH03427><WTH8799> covers 住.
LCC 上 (directional) left unannotated, matching treatment of UNV 往 which also carries no SN.

Judg/1.lcc_original: 猶大和他哥哥西緬一同去，擊殺了住洗法的迦南人，把那城盡行毀滅歸神。那城的名字便叫做何珥瑪【2】。

Three instances of WAH0853: (1) implicit {<WAH0853>} before 住, marking the Canaanites as direct object; (2) explicit 把那城<WAH0853>, where 把 = Chinese object marker mirroring Hebrew אֹתָהּ, tag placed after 那城; (3) implicit {<WAH0853>} before 何珥瑪 in the renaming clause

Judg/1.lcc_original: 猶大又攻取了迦薩和迦薩四境，亞實基倫和亞實基倫四境，以革倫和以革倫四境。

Judg/1.lcc_original: 永恆主和猶大同在，猶大就取得了山地；只是不能把山谷的居民趕出，因爲他們有鐵車。

LCC first clause '取得了山地' drops the explicit '的居民' found in UNV ('趕出山地的居民'); H3423 attaches to 取得了, H2022 to 山地; no LCC word exists for the implied 居民 so first-clause {<WAH0853>} stays implicit
LCC 把 is an explicit object-fronting particle serving the same role as Hebrew אֶת (H853) — Rule 3 applied: braces dropped, WAH0853 attaches to 把

Judg/1.lcc_original: 以色列人照摩西所說過的、將希伯崙給了迦勒；迦勒就從那裏把亞衲人的子孫三族系趕出。
notes: LCC uses bǎ-construction (把…趕出) vs UNV's verb-object order; 趕出<WH03423><WTH8686> shifts to clause-final position
{<WAH0853>} is implicit in UNV but LCC has explicit object marker 把; braces dropped and tag attached to 把 per Rule 3
UNV 三個族長 vs LCC 子孫三族系: Hebrew בֵּן (WH01121, sons/descendants) maps to 子孫; שָׁלֹשׁ (WH07969, three) maps to 三; 族系 is LCC's interpretive gloss with no Hebrew equivalent, left unannotated
LCC adds aspect particle 過 after 說 — Chinese grammatical particle with no Hebrew equivalent, left unannotated

Judg/1.lcc_sn: 至於住<WH03427><WTH8802>耶路撒冷<WH03389>的<WAH0853>耶布斯人<WH02983>、便雅憫<WH01144>人<WH01121>卻沒有<WAH03808>把他們趕出<WH03423><WTH8689>；於是耶布斯人<WH02983>和<WAH0854>便雅憫<WH01144>人<WH01121>就同住<WH03427><WTH8799>在耶路撒冷<WAH09002><WH03389>、直到<WAH05704>今<WAH02088>日<WH03117>。
Judg/1.lcc_original: 至於住耶路撒冷的耶布斯人、便雅憫人卻沒有把他們趕出；於是耶布斯人和便雅憫人就同住在耶路撒冷、直到今日。
notes: LCC topicalizes the Jebusites as the fronted topic (至於住耶路撒冷的耶布斯人), reversing UNV's subject-first order; all SNs are realigned to match the rearranged LCC structure.
LCC uses a 把-construction (把他們趕出) with explicit object pronoun 他們; both 把 and 他們 are Chinese-only additions with no Hebrew equivalents and are left unannotated.
LCC's 和 corresponds to UNV's 與 for WAH0854 (H854 = עִם/אֵת, 'with/and').
LCC adds discourse particles 於是 and 就 with no Hebrew equivalents; left unannotated.
WAH09002 (ב prefix on בִּירוּשָׁלִַם) is kept attached to 耶路撒冷 per UNV convention, even though LCC's 在 explicitly renders the ב.

Judg/1.lcc_original: 約瑟家也上去攻打伯特利；永恆主和他們同在。
notes: 耶和華 (UNV, WH03068) → 永恆主 (LCC): both render the Tetragrammaton YHWH; SN attached to 永恆主
與他們同在 (UNV) → 和他們同在 (LCC): 與/和 are synonyms for 'with'; WAH05973 attached to the full phrase ending 同在
{<WAH01992>} retained as implicit — LCC has no explicit pronoun corresponding to the Hebrew הֵם between 家 and 也

Judg/1.lcc_original: 約瑟家打發了人去窺探伯特利。那城從前名叫路斯。
notes: UNV 起先 → LCC 從前 (both mean 'formerly'); SNs WAH09001+WH06440 transferred to 從前
UNV parenthetical （那城...路斯） restructured as a separate sentence in LCC; SN assignments unchanged
LCC 了 (aspect particle after 打發) left unannotated — no Hebrew equivalent

Judg/1.lcc_original: 偵探看見一個人從城裏出來，就對他說：『請把進城的路指示我們，我們就恩待你。』
notes: 窺探的人 (participial phrase, Qal ptcp of שָׁמַר) collapses to 偵探 in LCC; both WH08104+WTH8802 attach to 偵探
求你 → 請: UNV uses two words for the entreaty (verb + pronoun), LCC uses one; WAH04994 (נָא) attaches to 請 which carries the full sense
將 → 把: both serve as BA-construction object markers; WAH0853 (אֵת direct object marker) attaches to 把
UNV 必 and LCC 就 are both modal/aspectual particles with no SN; left unannotated

Judg/1.lcc_original: 那人把進城的路指示他們，他們就用刀擊殺了城裏的人，但將那人和他全家放走。
notes: UNV 將→LCC 把 for object-marking particle; <WAH0853> (את) transferred after 把 by the same logic as UNV's post-將 placement
UNV 城中的居民→LCC 城裏的人: {<WAH0853>} kept in braces — Hebrew direct-object marker את has no explicit Chinese equivalent in either version; <WH05892> (עיר) attaches to 城
UNV 放去→LCC 放走: <WH07971><WTH8765> (שָׁלַח Piel) transferred to 放走 with no change in meaning
Second <WAH0853> placed after 和 (parallel to UNV structure) to mark 他全家 as the conjoined direct object

Judg/1.lcc_original: 那人往赫人之地去，建造了一座城，給它起名叫路斯；直到今日、那城還叫這名。
notes: 築了(H1129, banah=build) → 建造了: different lexeme, same Hebrew root; SN transferred cleanly
UNV splits 起<WH07121><WTH8799>名<WH08034> across two tokens; LCC combines as compound verb 起名, so all three tags consolidated on 起名 per rule 6
LCC adds 給它 (cf. Hebrew לָהּ = to it) which is absent from UNV SN annotations; left unannotated per rule 5
LCC fronts the temporal phrase (直到今日) before the subject (那城), reversing UNV word order; SNs redistributed to match Hebrew morphemes at their new positions
{<WAH01931>} kept with braces on 那城: H1931 (hû=it) is a copular/subject pronoun implicit in both UNV and LCC — LCC has no separate explicit word for it

Judg/1.lcc_original: 瑪拿西也沒有趕出伯善和屬伯善廂鎭的居民，他納和屬他納廂鎭的居民，多珥和屬多珥廂鎭的居民，以伯蓮和屬以伯蓮廂鎭的居民，米吉多和屬米吉多廂鎭的居民；這些迦南人執意住在那地。
notes: LCC's particle 也 (after 瑪拿西) has no Hebrew equivalent → left unannotated; WH04519 attaches directly after 瑪拿西.
LCC uses 廂鎭 (townships) where UNV has 鄉村 (villages) — both render Hebrew בְּנוֹת (H1323, daughters/dependent towns); WH01323 maps to 廂鎭 in each segment.
WH03427 (יֹשְׁבֵי, inhabitants) appears only on segments 3–5 (Dor, Ibleam, Megiddo), matching UNV: Hebrew uses יֹשְׁבֵי explicitly before those three city names but not for Beth-shan and Taanach.

Final clause restructured in LCC: 這些 before 迦南人 has no direct Hebrew antecedent (Hebrew has singular collective הַכְּנַעֲנִי) → 這些 left unannotated. Hebrew demonstrative הַזֹּאת (WAH02063) modifies הָאָרֶץ (the land) → mapped to LCC's 那 in 那地, with 地 receiving WAH09002+WH0776.

Judg/1.lcc_original: 到以色列強大了，就使迦南人作苦工，沒有把他們全部趕出。
notes: 及至 (UNV) → 到 (LCC): different temporal conjunctions but semantically equivalent; transferred <WAH01961><WAH03588> to 到
強盛 (UNV) → 強大 (LCC): variant phrasing for the same Hebrew root H2388 (חָזַק, 'to be strong'); morphology <WTH8804> (Qal perfect) preserved on 了
做 (UNV) → 作 (LCC): orthographic variant of the same word; SNs unchanged

Hebrew infinitive absolute + finite verb construction (ירשׁ H3423 × 2): UNV splits as 全然<WH03423><WTH8687> + 趕出<WH03423><WTH8689>; LCC 全部趕出 maps the same way — <WTH8687> (Hiphil inf. abs.) on 全部, <WTH8689> (Hiphil perfect) on 趕出
{<WAH0853>} kept implicit: LCC has no explicit accusative particle corresponding to את

Judg/1.lcc_original: 以法蓮也沒有把住基色的迦南人趕出；於是迦南人仍住在基色、在以法蓮中間。
notes: LCC restructures the first clause with a 把-construction, placing 趕出 at the end rather than before the object phrase. All SNs attach to their semantic equivalents regardless of the word-order difference.
把 mapped to {<WAH0853>} (Hebrew אֵת, direct object marker) per Rule 3: LCC has an explicit word serving exactly this grammatical function, so braces are dropped and the tag attaches to 把.
也 (Chinese additive particle 'also') and 仍 (Chinese adverb 'still') have no Hebrew equivalents and are left unannotated.
LCC's semicolon (；) and enumeration comma (、) are preserved exactly from the original text.

Judg/1.lcc_original: 西布倫沒有把基倫的居民和拿哈拉的居民趕出；於是迦南人仍住在西布倫中間，成了作苦工的人。
notes: LCC uses a 把-construction (把…趕出) while UNV places 趕出 before the object; all SN tags placed at semantically equivalent positions following LCC word order, with 趕出<WH03423><WTH8689> moved to end of clause.
UNV's implicit direct object marker {<WAH0853>} becomes the explicit 把 in LCC's 把-construction; braces dropped and tag attached to 把 per Rule 3.
LCC's 作苦工的人 is a paraphrase of UNV's 服苦的人; <WAH09001><WH04522> (H4522 מַס = corvée/forced labor) attached to the whole phrase.

Judg/2.lcc_original: 以色列人行了永恆主所看爲壞的事、去服事衆巴力【2】；

Judg/2.lcc_original: 永恆主向以色列人發怒，就把他們交在搶掠的人手中，這些人就搶擄他們；他又把他們交付【4】於他們四圍的仇敵的手中，以致他們在仇敵面前再也站不住。

Judg/3.lcc_original: 所留下的就是：非利士人的五個霸主、和一切迦南人、西頓人，和住利巴嫩山的希未人，從巴力黑們山直到哈馬口。
notes: UNV 非利士<WH06430> → LCC 非利士人; LCC adds 人 as part of the ethnonym, so WH06430 attaches after the full term 非利士人
UNV 首領<WH05633> → LCC 霸主; both render Hebrew סֶרֶן (seren, Philistine lord/tyrant); WH05633 attaches after 霸主

Judg/3.lcc_sn: 他們在那裏，這是要<WAH01961>藉着他們<WAH09002>來試驗<WAH09001><WH05254><WTH8763>{<WAH0853>}以色列人<WH03478>，好知道<WAH09001><WH03045><WTH8800>他們肯不肯聽從<WH08085><WTH8799>{<WAH0853>}永恆主<WH03068>的誡命<WH04687>、就是永恆主由<WAH09002>摩西<WH04872>經手<WH03027>所<WAH0834>吩咐<WH06680><WTH8765>{<WAH0853>}他們祖宗<WH01>的。
Judg/3.lcc_original: 他們在那裏，這是要藉着他們來試驗以色列人，好知道他們肯不肯聽從永恆主的誡命、就是永恆主由摩西經手所吩咐他們祖宗的。
notes: 他們在那裏 is LCC's contextual expansion of 'these remaining nations' with no dedicated Hebrew lexical item — left unannotated.
First WAH09002 (tagged on UNV's 留下這幾族) represents the ב in בָּם ('by/through them'). In LCC, 藉着他們 explicitly renders בָּם, so WAH09002 is attached there rather than to 他們在那裏.
LCC uses 永恆主 for יהוה (UNV: 耶和華) throughout — standard Lü rendering. WH03068 goes on the first occurrence only.
LCC has explicit 所 for the relative pronoun אֲשֶׁר, which UNV left implicit {WAH0834}. Per Rule 3, braces dropped: 所<WAH0834>.
LCC restructures clause order: 誡命 precedes the relative clause 由摩西…所吩咐…祖宗, whereas UNV places 誡命 at the end. SNs follow their lexical anchors regardless of reordering.
The second 永恆主 in LCC (explicit subject of 吩咐) makes the implicit Hebrew pronominal subject overt — left unannotated as it has no independent Hebrew lexeme.
WAH09002 appears twice in the verse for two distinct Hebrew ב constructions: בָּם (藉着他們) and בְּיַד (由…經手).

Judg/3.lcc_original: 於是以色列人住在迦南人、赫人、亞摩利人、比利洗人、希未人、耶布斯人中間，
notes: 於是 in LCC is a connective particle with no direct Hebrew equivalent — left unannotated
UNV's 竟 (concessive/aspect particle) is absent in LCC; the verb 住在 still receives <WH03427><WTH8804> as normal
All six people-group names align 1:1 with no reordering

Judg/3.lcc_original: 娶他們的女兒爲妻，把自己的女兒嫁給他們的兒子，並且服事他們的神。
notes: LCC uses 把 where UNV uses 將 for the accusative/topicalizer role of WAH0853 (וְאֶת); tagged 把<WAH0853> accordingly — same syntactic function, different lexical choice.
{<WAH09001>} before 爲妻 retained as implicit: it represents לָהֶם ('for themselves'), a Hebrew pronoun with no explicit counterpart in LCC.
LCC 爲妻 matches UNV 為妻; dual tag <WAH09001><WH0802> preserved after 爲妻 (לְנָשִׁים = lamed prefix + H802).
LCC 並且服事 vs UNV 並事奉 — same meaning (H5647, 'and served'); SNs attached to 服事 as the verbal head; 並且 is a Chinese connector without a separately tagged Hebrew correspondent.

Judg/3.lcc_original: 以色列人行了永恆主所看爲壞的事，忘了永恆主他們的上帝，去服事衆巴力【1】和亞舍拉神木。
notes: LCC '永恆主' (Eternal Lord) renders UNV '耶和華' for יְהוָה — both receive <WH03068>
LCC '上帝' renders UNV '神' for אֱלֹהִים — tagged <WH0430>
LCC lacks an explicit '眼中' word; the relative clause '所看爲' covers UNV '眼中看為' (בְּעֵינֵי); <WAH09002><WH05869> attached to '看爲' as the closest semantic anchor for 'in-eyes-of'
LCC '亞舍拉神木' adds a gloss '神木' (Asherah poles/sacred trees) absent from UNV/Hebrew; <WH0842> attached only to '亞舍拉', '神木' left unannotated
Aspect particles '了' (×2) and the gloss '神木' left unannotated; footnote marker '【1】' preserved in position after 衆巴力<WH01168>

Judg/3.lcc_original: 因此永恆主向以色列人發怒，就把他們交付【2】於米所波大米王古珊利薩田手中；以色列人服事了古珊利薩田八年。
notes: 永恆主 (LCC) = 耶和華 (UNV) — both render YHWH; WH03068 transferred correctly
【2】 is a LCC editorial footnote marker preserved in situ after 交付's SN tags
LCC 於 (preposition before 米所波大米) carries no independent SN — the Hebrew locative ב is already captured by WAH09002 on 手中
了 (perfective aspect particle after 服事) has no Hebrew equivalent and is left unannotated per rule 5
{<WAH0853>} (direct object marker אֵת) retained as implicit — LCC has no explicit word for it
First clause 向以色列人 = Hebrew בְּיִשְׂרָאֵל: ב prefix → WAH09002, יִשְׂרָאֵל → WH03478; both tags placed after 人
Second clause 以色列人 = Hebrew בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל: WH03478 (Israel) + WH01121 (בֵּן sons/people) both attached to the unified LCC phrase 以色列人
Missing SNs: 0639

Judg/3.lcc_original: 以色列人向永恆主哀呼，永恆主就爲以色列人興起了一位拯救者來拯救他們，就是迦勒的兄弟、那比他小的、基納斯的兒子俄陀聶。
notes: LCC has explicit 向 for UNV's implicit {<WAH0413>} (אֶל = to/unto) — dropped braces per Rule 3 and attached to 向.
永恆主 is LCC's rendering of UNV's 耶和華 (H3068) — tagged both occurrences.
Second occurrence of 以色列人 in LCC is explicit where UNV has 他們; split as 以色列<WH03478>人<WAH09001><WH01121> to align H3478 to 以色列 and the lamed prefix + H1121 to 人.

UNV attaches both H6996 (younger) and H251 (brother) to a single 兄弟; LCC separates the concepts. H251 → 兄弟; H6996 → 那比他小的. Hebrew מִמֶּנּוּ (H4480, 'than him') is explicit in LCC's 比他 inside 那比他小的 — dropped braces per Rule 3 and appended after H6996 on that phrase.
了 (perfective aspect particle after 興起) and 來 (purposive complement before 拯救) are Chinese grammatical particles with no Hebrew equivalents — left unannotated.

Judg/3.lcc_original: 永恆主的靈感動他，他就作士師來拯救以色列；他出去爭戰，永恆主將亞蘭王古珊利薩田交在他手中，他的手就強過古珊利薩田。
notes: UNV '降在他身上' (WAH01961+WAH05921, i.e., הָיְתָה עָלָיו) → LCC '感動他': <WAH01961> placed on 感動 (the verbal action of coming/being upon), <WAH05921> placed on 他 (the recipient, 'upon him'). LCC rephrases idiomatically.
UNV '美索不達米亞' → LCC '亞蘭': both render <WH0758> (ארם). LCC's '亞蘭' is in fact the more literal rendering of the Hebrew.
LCC '他的手<WH03027>' explicitly renders יָד (hand) where UNV rendered it ambiguously on the pronoun 他. The Hebrew יָדוֹ ('his hand') maps cleanly to LCC's 他的手.
LCC '強過' renders WH05810 (חָזַק/prevailed) + {WAH05921} (עַל/over). 過 is an explicit Chinese word expressing the 'over/surpassing' relation, so braces on WAH05921 are dropped per Rule 3.
LCC '來拯救' expands שָׁפַט's saving/delivering aspect; no SN assigned to 拯救 itself as it is LCC's interpretive unpacking of the Hebrew verb, which is wholly captured by WH08199 on 士師.
{<WAH0853>} kept implicit in both instances as Chinese has no accusative particle; placed immediately before the marked noun (以色列, 亞蘭王古珊利薩田) in each case.

Judg/3.lcc_original: 於是地方太平四十年。基納斯的兒子俄陀聶死了。
notes: UNV 國中 (H0776, אֶרֶץ = land/earth) → LCC 地方 (place/region): both render the same Hebrew word; H0776 attaches to 地方.

Judg/3.lcc_original: 以色列人又行了永恆主所看爲壞的事，永恆主就使摩押王伊磯倫強盛，來攻擊以色列人，因爲以色列人行了永恆主所看爲壞的事。

Ruth/1.lcc_original: 當士師執政的日子、猶大地鬧饑荒；有一個人從猶大伯利恆往摩押鄉間去寄居；他和他妻子跟兩個兒子一同去。
notes: 猶大地 in first clause: LCC specifies 'land of Judah' where Hebrew and UNV only say 'the land' (H0776); the first 猶大 is LCC's interpretive addition with no SN tag; H03063 (יְהוּדָה) is attached only to the second 猶大 (從猶大伯利恆) where it directly modifies Bethlehem in the Hebrew
從<WAH04480>: LCC uses a freestanding preposition 從 where Hebrew/UNV has מִן as a bound prefix on Bethlehem; <WAH04480> is detached and placed on 從 rather than on 伯利恆
他<WAH01931>: UNV marks this pronoun as implicit {<WAH01931>}; per Rule 3, braces are dropped because LCC provides the explicit pronoun 他

Ruth/1.lcc_original: 這人名叫以利米勒，他妻子名叫拿俄米，他那兩個兒子名叫瑪倫基連；都是猶大伯利恆的以法他人；他們到了摩押鄉間，就住在那裏。

Ruth/1.unv_sn_reference: 後來拿俄米<WH05281>的丈夫<WH0376>以利米勒<WH0458>死了<WH04191><WTH8799>，剩下<WH07604><WTH8735>婦人{<WAH01931>}和她兩個<WH08147>兒子<WH01121>。
notes: UNV '她兩個' → LCC '那兩個': the pronoun 她 (her) is replaced by the demonstrative 那 (that/those). SN WH08147 (שְׁנַיִם, two) attaches to 兩個 in both cases without ambiguity.
{<WAH01931>} kept as implicit braces: LCC also lacks an explicit pronoun word for the Hebrew הִיא at this position, same as UNV.

LCC 永恆主 renders H03068 (יְהוָה/LORD); LCC 永活 renders H02416 (חַי/living) — straightforward lexical substitutions for LCC's distinctive divine name convention.
