Ruth/3.lcc_sn: 路得便在他腳所蓋的地方<WH04772>躺<WH07901><WTH8799>到<WAH05704>天亮<WH01242>；在人<WH0376>彼此<WAH0853><WH07453>不能<WAH09002><WH02958>辨認<WH05234><WTH8686>的時候、路得就起來了<WH06965><WTH8799>；波阿斯心裏說<WH0559><WTH8799>：『可別<WAH0408>讓人知道<WH03045><WTH8735>{<WAH03588>}有女子<WH0802>到<WH0935><WTH8804>禾場上<WH01637>來纔好呢。』
Ruth/3.lcc_original: 路得便在他腳所蓋的地方躺到天亮；在人彼此不能辨認的時候、路得就起來了；波阿斯心裏說：『可別讓人知道有女子到禾場上來纔好呢。』
notes: UNV「腳下」(WH04772, מרגלות) → LCC「腳所蓋的地方」— same semantic referent (the area at his feet); SN attached to end of full phrase
UNV「天快亮」(WH01242, בֹּקֶר) → LCC「天亮」— identical meaning, minor phrasing difference; SN placed after 天亮
LCC adds「心裏」to「波阿斯心裏說」— no Hebrew equivalent for this addition; left unannotated, SN attached to 說 as in UNV
{<WAH03588>} kept implicit — LCC's「纔好呢」is an idiomatic amplification of the speech act, not a direct rendering of כִּי; no single LCC word maps cleanly to it
LCC「到…來」resultative structure for בּוֹא (WH0935+WTH8804) — 到 tagged per UNV parallel position; directional 來 left unannotated as it is a grammatical complement with no separate Hebrew lexeme

Ruth/3.lcc_original: 又對路得說：『把你身上的外披卸下，拿住它』；路得就拿住；波阿斯量了六簸箕大麥，幫她扛在肩膀上，她便進城去了。
notes: WH03051 (יהב, 'give/bring', imperative) was implicit {}{} in UNV with no corresponding Chinese word. LCC's 卸下 ('take down/remove') occupies the same first-verb structural slot, so WH03051 is attached explicitly to 卸下 per Rule 3 (LCC has an explicit word) — though the sense differs: UNV's Hebrew root means 'bring/give' while LCC renders the action as 'remove/unfasten.' This is the main alignment uncertainty.
WH0270 (אחז, 'hold/grasp') maps cleanly to LCC's 拿住 ('hold/grasp') in both occurrences: in the speech and in the narrative response (路得就拿住). UNV's 打開 was a looser rendering of the same root.
WAH09002 (ב prefix, 'with/in it') attaches to 它 (the explicit pronoun object) in the speech quotation, and directly to 拿住 in the narrative clause where LCC omits the pronoun.
Two WAH05921 (על, 'upon') tags are preserved as in UNV: the first on 幫她 ('for/upon her') and the second on 在肩膀上 ('upon her shoulder') — LCC uses 肩膀 vs. UNV's 肩 but the mapping is identical.
去了 (perfective aspect particle) is left unannotated, consistent with UNV where it also carries no SN.

Ruth/3.lcc_original: 路得來到婆婆跟前，婆婆說：『女兒阿，你怎麼啦？』路得就將那人向她所行的都告訴婆婆。
notes: 來到 in LCC combines UNV's 回<WH0935><WTH8799> and 到<WAH0413> into one compound verb; both SNs are attached to 來到 together.

UNV 怎麼樣了<WAH04310><WAH0859> has both SNs stacked at the end; LCC splits them to their respective words: 你<WAH0859> (H859=אַתְּ=you) and 怎麼<WAH04310> (H4310=מִי/מָה=what), reversing the word order to match LCC's syntax.
UNV {<WAH09001>} (implicit לָהּ) at the end of the clause: LCC makes this explicit with 婆婆 (告訴 target), so per Rule 3 braces are dropped and <WAH09001> attaches to 婆婆.
LCC 都 (all/altogether) has no Hebrew equivalent; left unannotated.

Ruth/3.lcc_original: 又說：『這六簸箕大麥是他給我的，因爲他說：「你不可空手去見你婆婆。」』
notes: LCC topicalizes the object (這六簸箕大麥是他給我的) vs UNV's SVO order (那人給了我六簸箕大麥); SNs redistributed to semantically matching words despite reordering
{<WAH0428>} (הָאֵלֶּה 'these') is implicit in UNV but LCC has explicit 這 — dropped braces per rule 3
{<WAH03588>} (כִּי 'because') is implicit in UNV but LCC has explicit 因爲 — dropped braces per rule 3
UNV 對我說 → LCC 他說: the 'to me' direction is dropped in LCC; <WH0559><WTH8804> attached to 他說 as the closest match
<WAH0413> (אֶל, preposition 'to') maps to 見 in both UNV and LCC, since Chinese renders the directional motion idiomatically as 'see/meet' rather than a bare preposition

Ruth/3.lcc_original: 婆婆說：『我女兒阿，你只管坐着，等你知道這事究竟怎樣，因爲那人今天不將這事辦成、他總不罷休的。』
notes: UNV '安坐等候' (WH03427 יָשַׁב = sit/remain) maps to LCC '坐着' only; the waiting component is handled separately by LCC's '等'
LCC '等' explicitly renders the implicit {<WAH05704>}{<WAH0834>} (עַד אֲשֶׁר = until that); per Rule 3, braces dropped and tags attach directly to '等'
WH05307 (יִפֹּל = fall/turn out) attaches to '怎樣' since LCC has no separate word for UNV '成就'; '究竟' is LCC-added elaboration with no Hebrew equivalent and is left unannotated
LCC inverts word order from UNV '辦成…這事' to '這事辦成'; 這事<WH01697> is tagged at its LCC position (before 辦成), with implicit {<WAH03588>}{<WAH0518>} inserted immediately before the verb 辦成
LCC adds pronoun '他' (subject of second clause) and final particle '的' — both left unannotated as Chinese grammatical additions
UNV '必不<WAH03808>' maps to LCC '總不'; '總' is a reinforcing adverb added by LCC so WAH03808 attaches to '總不' as a unit

Ruth/4.lcc_original: 波阿斯上城門去，坐在那裏；恰巧波阿斯所說的那位贖業至親從那裏經過了；波阿斯說：『某某人哪，請轉身坐在這裏吧！』他就轉身坐下。
notes: WH05927 (עָלָה = go up) attaches to 上 in LCC's 上城門去; WH08179 (gate) attaches to 城門; 去 is a LCC directional complement with no Hebrew backing, left unannotated
LCC 那位贖業至親 renders UNV 那至近的親屬 (WH01350 = גָּאַל = kinsman-redeemer); mapping is clear despite different Chinese phrasing
LCC 從那裏 in the kinsman-passing clause has no direct Hebrew equivalent (Hebrew lacks 'from there' here); left unannotated
LCC 某某人哪 doubles 某 to render two distinct Hebrew words WH06423 (פְּלֹנִי) and WH0492 (אַלְמֹנִי); both tags attach after the full vocative phrase
LCC 請轉身 renders UNV 你來 (WH05493 = סוּר = turn aside); tag attaches to 轉身, 請 is a LCC politeness particle with no Hebrew backing
Third instance of 波阿斯 (before 說) carries no SN in UNV; not tagged in LCC either — WH0559 (אָמַר) belongs to 說 alone

1Sam/1.lcc_sn: 以法蓮<WH0669>山地<WH04480><WH02022>有<WH01961><WTH8799>一個<WH0259>人<WH0376>屬於拉瑪地<WH07436>、是蘇弗人【1】，他名<WH08034>叫以利加拿<WH0511>，是以法蓮人<WH0673>蘇弗<WH06689>的元孫<WH01121>，託戶<WH08459>的曾孫<WH01121>，以利戶<WH0453>的孫子<WH01121>，耶羅罕<WH03395>的兒子<WH01121>。
1Sam/1.lcc_original: 以法蓮山地有一個人屬於拉瑪地、是蘇弗人【1】，他名叫以利加拿，是以法蓮人蘇弗的元孫，託戶的曾孫，以利戶的孫子，耶羅罕的兒子。
notes: 是蘇弗人【1】 left unannotated: LCC-specific gloss linking the Zophim element of Ramathaim-Zophim to the Zuph clan; no distinct Hebrew token maps here independently — WH06689 (צוּף) attaches only to the genealogical 蘇弗 in 蘇弗的元孫

WH04480 (מִן 'from') and WH02022 (הַר 'mountain') both attached to 山地, following UNV's pattern for the second מֵהַר phrase; LCC's 屬於 preposition (before 拉瑪地) left unannotated since the first מִן is subsumed into WH07436
LCC repositions 以法蓮人 (WH0673 = אֶפְרָתִי, Ephraimite) inside the genealogy clause (是以法蓮人蘇弗的元孫) rather than as an early descriptor as in UNV — tag placed after 以法蓮人 in LCC's own word order
人 in 以法蓮人 is a Chinese compounding device for the adjective אֶפְרָתִי and receives no separate tag; WH0376 (אִישׁ = man) is already tagged on 人 in 一個人

1Sam/1.lcc_original: 他有兩個妻子，一個名叫哈拿，一個名叫毘尼拿；毘尼拿有孩子，哈拿沒有孩子。
notes: LCC 妻子 (two chars) vs UNV 妻 — WH0802 (אִשָּׁה) attached after 妻子 as the full LCC word for 'wife'
LCC 名叫 vs UNV 名 — WH08034 (שֵׁם, 'name') attached after 名叫; LCC uses a verb phrase where UNV uses just the noun
LCC 一個 includes measure word 個 absent in UNV's 一 — WH0259 and WH08145 attached after the full 一個 phrase
LCC 孩子 vs UNV 兒女 — both render יֶלֶד (WH03206); tag attached after 孩子 in both occurrences
WAH09001 prefix positions preserved from UNV: before 兩個, before second 毘尼拿, before second 哈拿

1Sam/1.lcc_original: 這人年年從本城上示羅去敬拜、獻祭給萬軍之永恆主；在那裏有以利的兩個兒子、何弗尼非尼哈、做永恆主的祭司。
notes: 每年 (UNV) → 年年 (LCC): different Chinese phrasings for 'annually'; all three tags (WAH04480+WH03117+WH03117 = מִיָּמִים יָמִימָה 'from days to days') condensed onto 年年
到示羅 (UNV): 到 expresses the locative prefix WAH09002 explicitly; LCC replaces it with directional complement 去 (unannotated), so WAH09002+WH07887 attach to 示羅
祭祀 (UNV) → 獻祭 (LCC): synonymous but distinct Chinese renderings of H02076 (זָבַח 'to sacrifice')
耶和華 (UNV) → 永恆主 (LCC): LCC's distinctive translation of YHWH (H03068); same SN applied at both occurrences in the verse
給 (LCC's explicit 'to/for' preposition) left unannotated; its semantic role is already expressed by the WAH09001 (ל prefix) bundled with 永恆主
做 (LCC 'serve as') left unannotated, mirroring UNV's 當 which is also untagged; Hebrew uses a nominal predicate without explicit verb SN

1Sam/1.lcc_sn: 這一天<WH03117>、以利加拿<WH0511>獻祭<WH02076><WTH8799>的時候<WAH01961>，哈拿竟哭了，不喫飯。起因是：以利加拿常將祭肉<WH04490>分兒給<WH05414><WTH8804>他的妻子<WH0802>毘尼拿<WAH09001><WH06444>和<WAH09001><WAH03605>毘尼拿的兒<WH01121>女<WH01323>；
1Sam/1.lcc_original: 這一天、以利加拿獻祭的時候，哈拿竟哭了，不喫飯。起因是：以利加拿常將祭肉分兒給他的妻子毘尼拿和毘尼拿的兒女；
notes: LCC restructures verse 4 into a temporal frame (以利加拿獻祭的時候) plus a causal clause (起因是：以利加拿常將…); SNs are distributed across both parts accordingly.
WAH01961 (וַיְהִי, vayehi = 'and it came to pass/whenever') placed on 的時候 rather than 常; 的時候 captures the temporal frame of the Hebrew introductory formula, while 這一天 takes H3117 (הַיּוֹם = the day).

LCC has two occurrences of 以利加拿 but Hebrew has only one. The first (以利加拿獻祭的時候) is tagged H511 as the explicit subject introduction matching Hebrew word order; the second (起因是：以利加拿常將) is LCC's structural repetition for the causal clause and receives no tag.
哈拿竟哭了，不喫飯。起因是 — left untagged; this content is absent from the UNV verse 4 SN data and appears to reflect LCC narrative restructuring or material from v.7.
WAH03605 (כָּל, 'all') kept on 和 per UNV pattern; LCC's 毘尼拿的兒女 lacks an explicit 'all' word but the semantics are absorbed into the phrase.

1Sam/1.lcc_original: 雖然【2】他比較愛哈拿，給哈拿的倒只有一分，是因爲永恆主閉着她的子宮。
notes: claude CLI error:

1Sam/1.lcc_original: 只因永恆主閉着她的子宮，她的對頭就大大惹了她發怒，要使她大發雷霆。
notes: 只因 maps to <WAH03588> (כִּי H3588 = because/for); UNV renders it as 見 ('seeing that'), LCC as 只因 ('only because') — both express the causal subordinator.
LCC replaces proper nouns 毘尼拿 and 哈拿 with pronouns; 她的對頭<WH06869> absorbs both Peninnah-as-subject and H6869 (צָרָה, rival/adversary).
閉着<WH05462><WTH8804> maps the qal-perfect 'closed' (H5462 סָגַר + morphology WTH8804); LCC's progressive aspect marker 着 is aspectual only and does not affect SN assignment.
她的子宮 covers both H1157 (בְּעַד, preposition 'through/behind') and H7358 (רֶחֶם, womb); both SNs attached jointly at phrase end since the whole phrase corresponds to the Hebrew בְּעַד רַחְמָהּ.
גַּם (H1571, 'also') has no explicit LCC correlate; retained as implicit {<WAH01571>} placed after the verb complex, before the object+cognate-object cluster.
發怒 maps to H3708 (כַּעַס, vexation/anger), the cognate accusative object in the Hebrew construction גַּם כַּעַס ('with provocation'); LCC renders the whole idiom 大大惹了她發怒.

要使<WAH09002><WAH05668> carries the purpose-clause markers (ל prefix + בַּעֲבוּר H5668 = 'in order to'); 大發雷霆<WH07481><WTH8687> carries the hiphil-infinitive H7481 (רָגַז, to rage/cause to tremble) + morphology WTH8687.

1Sam/1.lcc_original: 這樣、年年都是如此：每逢她上永恆主的殿，毘尼拿總是這樣惹她發怒，以致她哭了，不喫飯。
notes: LCC condenses UNV's first clause: 'Elkanah would give Hannah a double portion' (以利加拿都以雙分給哈拿) is absorbed into '這樣...都是如此'; <WH06213><WTH8799> (יַעֲשֶׂה, 'he would do') is placed after 如此 as the closest semantic anchor, though 如此 means 'like this' rather than 'do'
年年 covers two Hebrew SNs for שָׁנָה בְשָׁנָה (year by year): <WH08141><WAH09002><WH08141> both attach to the one Chinese word
每逢 covers מִדֵּי <WAH04480><WH01767> (as often as/whenever); 她 carries the implicit subject of עֲלֹתָהּ but <WH05927><WTH8800> attaches to the main verb 上
永恆主 is LCC's rendering of יְהוָה; assigned <WH03068>
總是這樣 covers the second כֵּן <WAH03651>; SN placed after 這樣 as primary semantic carrier of 'thus'
惹她發怒 covers תַּכְעִסֶנָּה (provoke her to anger); SN placed after the full phrase at 發怒

1Sam/1.lcc_original: 她的丈夫以利加拿對她說：『哈拿阿，你爲甚麼哭？爲甚麼不喫飯？爲甚麼心裏難過呢？在你看，我不是比十個兒子還好麼？』
notes: Three instances of {<WAH09001>}{<WAH04100>} (implicit 'why/wherefore') in UNV become the explicit word 爲甚麼 in LCC for all three rhetorical questions; braces dropped per rule 3.
LCC's 在你看 ('in your view/eyes') is an idiomatic Chinese expansion with no directly tagged Hebrew SN in the UNV source; left unannotated.
LCC rephrases the final clause from UNV's 有我不…嗎 to 我不是…麼; WAH03808 (negation לֹא) attached to 不, and 是 left unannotated as a Chinese copula with no Hebrew equivalent.
LCC 難過 corresponds to UNV 愁悶 (WH07489 = רָעַע, be bad/displeasing); LCC 喫飯 is the same word as UNV 吃飯 in a different character variant.

1Sam/1.lcc_original: 人在示羅喫完了飯，也喝完了酒，哈拿就站起來；祭司以利在永恆主殿堂的門柱旁在他的位上坐着。
notes: UNV {<WH0310>} (implicit 'after') maps to LCC's first 完了 after 喫 — explicit in LCC so braces dropped and tag applied normally
LCC restructures UNV '吃…喝完了' into parallel '喫完了飯，也喝完了酒'; each 完了 anchors one H310 instance
LCC adds 飯 and 酒 for Chinese naturalness with no direct Hebrew equivalents — left unannotated
LCC reverses clause order in final phrase: UNV '坐<H3427>在<WAH05921>位<H3678>上' → LCC '在<WAH05921>位<H3678>上坐<H3427>着'; tags placed in LCC word order
耶和華 (H3068) → LCC 永恆主; 殿 (H1964) → 殿堂; 門框 (H4201) → 門柱 — different lexemes, same Hebrew referents
着 is a Chinese aspect particle with no Hebrew equivalent — unannotated

1Sam/1.lcc_original: 哈拿心裏愁苦，就向永恆主祈禱，直痛哭飲泣。
notes: LCC reorders clauses relative to UNV: UNV places weeping (痛痛哭泣) before praying, LCC places praying before weeping — matching Hebrew syntax (וַתִּתְפַּלֵּל...בָּכֹה תִבְכֶּה) more closely; SNs assigned accordingly to their semantic targets in LCC word order.
{<WAH05921>} is implicit (no explicit Chinese) in UNV, but LCC explicitly renders עַל as 向; braces dropped and <WAH05921> attached directly to 向.
耶和華<WH03068> (YHWH) in UNV → 永恆主<WH03068> in LCC; Lü's characteristic rendering of the divine name as 永恆主.

Hebrew infinitive absolute בָּכֹה תִבְכֶּה is split across LCC's 直痛哭飲泣: <WH01058><WTH8800> (inf. absolute intensifier) attached to 痛哭, <WH01058><WTH8799> (finite imperfect) attached to 飲泣; moderate uncertainty here since LCC treats this as one continuous phrase.

1Sam/1.lcc_original: 她許個願說：『萬軍之永恆主阿，你若眞地看到使女的困苦，眷念到我，不忘了使女，而賜給使女一個男的後裔，那麼我就要使他儘他一生的日子獻與永恆主，剃刀總不上到他的頭。』
notes: UNV treats 許願 as a compound verb-noun pair; split across LCC's 許(H05087+WTH8799) and 個願(H05088) since 許=vow(verb) and 個願=a vow(noun) map naturally.

Hebrew infinitive absolute רָאֹה (H07200+WTH8800) mapped to LCC's adverbial 眞地 rather than a verb; the finite imperfect (H07200+WTH8799) maps to 看到. This preserves the emphatic 'surely see' function LCC renders as 眞地看到.
Hebrew verb זָכַרְתַּנִי includes first-person object suffix 'me'; LCC makes this explicit with 到我. Entire phrase 眷念到我 carries H02142+WTH8804.
LCC second 使女 in 賜給使女 receives WAH09001+H0519, representing the dative ל+אָמָה (to [the] maidservant) from Hebrew וְנָתַתָּה לַאֲמָתְךָ.

LCC 儘他一生的日子 reverses Hebrew/UNV order: Hebrew כָּל יְמֵי חַיָּיו = all(WAH03605) + days(WH03117) + his-life(WH02416), but LCC puts 一生(WH02416) before 日子(WH03117). SNs assigned per LCC's actual word order.
LCC 總不 takes WAH03808 on 總不 as a unit; 總 is LCC's emphatic intensifier with no separate Hebrew lexeme.
{WAH05921} kept implicit: LCC 上到 is a directional compound verb where 到 conveys direction-to-destination rather than clearly lexicalizing עַל (upon). UNV also leaves WAH05921 implicit.
LCC 永恆主 is LCC's rendering of יהוה (H03068) throughout; 獻與 absorbs the dative ל (WAH09001) into the verb phrase.

1Sam/1.lcc_original: 哈拿在永恆主面前不住地祈禱，以利直觀察看她的嘴。
notes: 耶和華 (WH03068) → LCC 永恆主: different rendering of יהוה but clearly the same referent; SN attaches to 永恆主
定睛看 (UNV, WH08104 שׁמר) → LCC 直觀察看: LCC expands into a fuller phrase; both SNs (WH08104 + WTH8802) attach to the end of 直觀察看
Both leading implicit markers {<WAH01961>} (היה, continuative sense) and {<WAH03588>} (כִּי, subordinating conjunction) are retained in braces — LCC has no explicit words for either
Implicit {<WAH0853>} (את direct object marker) retained in braces before 她的嘴 as LCC has no explicit equivalent

1Sam/1.lcc_original: 原來哈拿是心中念念有詞，只是嘴脣動動，聲音卻聽不到，因此以利以爲她是個喝醉了的婦人。
notes: {<WAH01931>} kept implicit: LCC's 是 is a structural copula, not an explicit rendering of הִיא (she); the pronoun remains implicit.
LCC 念念有詞 maps to UNV 默禱 (<WH01696><WTH8764> = דִּבֶּר speak/pray); the phrase is richer but semantically equivalent.
LCC reverses UNV noun-verb order: UNV 動嘴唇 (verb-noun) becomes LCC 嘴脣動動 (noun-verb); tags follow LCC order — 嘴脣<WH08193>動動<WH05128><WTH8801>.
LCC 聲音卻聽不到 restructures UNV 不出聲音: <WH08085><WTH8735> (שָׁמַע be heard) attaches to 聽, <WAH03808> (לֹא) to 不; 卻 and 到 are LCC structural additions left unannotated.

LCC restructures the clause: 從他們 is fronted before the verb (奪取了), whereas in UNV the {<WAH04480>}{<WAH0854>} appear after 城邑. 從 takes <WAH04480>; {<WAH0854>} (second object/with marker) stays implicit after 帳篷村.

WAH09002 (ב inseparable prefix = 'in/at') attached to 進去 (went in), because LCC reads the Hebrew בְּכָלֵב as a euphemism for sexual entry rather than the locative preposition of a place name.

祖 (ancestor/patriarch) ← WH01 (אָב); LCC uses a broader kinship term where UNV has 父親 (father). Tag placed on 祖.

{<WAH01961>}{<WAH09003>}{<WAH0834>} (וַיְהִי כַּאֲשֶׁר = 'and it came to pass when') remain implicit — LCC omits this temporal frame and begins directly with 參巴拉
LCC 在 (Chinese progressive aspect marker before 修造) has no independent Hebrew equivalent — left unannotated; the participle aspect is already captured by <WTH8802> on 修造
LCC 直 (continuative adverb, 'kept/continued') has no direct Hebrew equivalent — left unannotated
LCC 嗤笑着 — SN tags attached after 嗤笑 and before aspect particle 着 (着 is a Chinese grammatical particle per Rule 5, unannotated): 嗤笑<WH03932><WTH8686>着
Missing SNs: 09001

Neh/4.lcc_sn: {<WH0559>}{<WTH8799>}他在他的族弟兄<WH0251>和撒瑪利亞<WH08111>的軍兵<WH02428>面前<WAH09001><WH06440>說<WH0559><WTH8799>：『嘿！這些衰弱憔悴<WH0537>的猶大人<WH03064>要作<WH06213><WTH8802>甚麼<WAH04100>？他們要奮不顧身<WH05800><WTH8799><WAH09001>麼？要宰獻祭牲<WH02076><WTH8799>動工麼？要在一天<WAH09002><WH03117>之內就作完<WH03615><WTH8762>麼？他們<WAH01992>要從塵土<WH06083>廢堆<WAH04480><WH06194>中拿火燒過<WH08313><WTH8803>的石頭<WH068>把<WAH0853>它重新建造起來<WH02421><WTH8762>【2】麼？』
Neh/4.lcc_original: 他在他的族弟兄和撒瑪利亞的軍兵面前說：『嘿！這些衰弱憔悴的猶大人要作甚麼？他們要奮不顧身麼？要宰獻祭牲動工麼？要在一天之內就作完麼？他們要從塵土廢堆中拿火燒過的石頭把它重新建造起來【2】麼？』
notes: First {<WH0559>}{<WTH8799>} kept implicit — LCC has no separate introductory 'he spoke' verb before 在; the second 說<WH0559><WTH8799> accounts for the one explicit 'said'.
對<WAH09001><WH06440> → 面前<WAH09001><WH06440> — LCC expresses לִפְנֵי (H6440 + ל prefix) via the 在…面前 frame; tag placed after 面前 as the head noun of the prepositional phrase.

保護<WH05800><WTH8799>自己<WAH09001> → 奮不顧身<WH05800><WTH8799><WAH09001> — LCC renders H5800 (עָזַב 'forsake/leave') + reflexive dative pronoun (WAH09001 = לָהֶם) as the 4-character idiom 奮不顧身; both SNs grouped at end of idiom since no separate reflexive word exists.
{<WAH01992>} → 他們<WAH01992> — LCC provides explicit pronoun at this clause; braces dropped per Rule 3.
{<WAH0853>} → 把<WAH0853> — LCC uses 把 as the direct-object marker equivalent of אֵת; braces dropped per Rule 3, tag placed after 把.
LCC's 嘿！(exclamatory interjection) and 動工 ('start work', appended to the sacrifice question) have no UNV SN counterparts and are left unannotated.

Neh/4.lcc_sn: 亞捫人<WH05984>多比雅<WH02900>在參巴拉旁邊<WH0681>，他也說<WH0559><WTH8799>：『哼！這些人<WAH01992>所<WAH0834>修造<WH01129><WTH8802>的、就使<WAH0518>一隻狐狸<WH07776>上去<WH05927><WTH8799>，也<WAH01571>會把這些石<WH068>墻<WH02346>跐個破口<WH06555><WTH8804>的！』
Neh/4.lcc_original: 亞捫人多比雅在參巴拉旁邊，他也說：『哼！這些人所修造的、就使一隻狐狸上去，也會把這些石墻跐個破口的！』
notes: H0681 (אֵצֶל, beside) attached to 旁邊; LCC expands UNV's 站在旁邊 to 在參巴拉旁邊, explicitly naming Sanballat — SN placed on 旁邊 which is the semantic core.
LCC's 他也說: 他 and the narrative 也 are Chinese additions with no Hebrew counterpart; only 說 receives H0559/WTH8799.
哼！ is a LCC interjection (rhetorical exclamation) with no Hebrew equivalent — left unannotated.
石墻 split into 石<WH068>墻<WH02346>: H068 (אֶבֶן, stone) and H02346 (חוֹמָה, wall) are distinct Hebrew words.

LCC restructures the consequence clause as 也會把這些石墻跐個破口的 vs UNV's 也必跐倒; 也<WAH01571> maps to גַּם, and 跐個破口<WH06555><WTH8804> maps to UNV's 跐倒 (פָּרַץ, H06555) — LCC's expanded phrasing 會把這些 is Chinese addition left unannotated.

Neh/4.lcc_original: 我們的上帝阿，求你垂聽我們怎樣地被藐視；求你使他們的毀謗回到他們自己的頭上，使他們在被擄之地作爲被掠之物。
Neh/4.unv_sn_reference: 我們的　神<WH0430>啊，求你垂聽<WH08085><WTH8798>，因為<WAH03588>我們被<WAH01961>藐視<WH0939>。求你使他們的毀謗<WH02781>歸<WH07725><WTH8685>於<WAH0413>他們的頭<WH07218>上，使他們<WH05414><WTH8798>在擄到<WH07633>之地<WAH09002><WH0776>作為掠物<WAH09001><WH0961>。

Esth/1.lcc_original: 當亞哈隨魯的日子──這是那位從印度到古實統治一百二十七省的亞哈隨魯──
notes: H1961 (וַיְהִי, narrative-opening verb) remains implicit {WAH01961}: LCC's temporal idiom 當…的日子 restructures the clause without an explicit 'came to pass' verb, so no single Chinese word maps cleanly to it.
當 absorbs ב prefix (H9002); 日子 = H3117 (yom); first 亞哈隨魯 = H325 — all three were implicit in UNV but LCC makes them explicit, so braces removed per Rule 3.
LCC's 這 = H1931 (הוּא 'this/he'); 是 is a Chinese copula bridging the verbless Hebrew clause — no SN assigned to 是.
LCC's 統治 = sole rendering of H4427 (הַמֹּלֵךְ). UNV split this verb across 作王 (tagged H4427) and 統管 (no SN, a Chinese stylistic addition); LCC uses 統治 for the entire concept.
Second 亞哈隨魯 (H325) placed at the end of LCC's dash-bounded parenthetical, matching the second Hebrew אֲחַשְׁוֵרוֹשׁ in the source text.

Esth/1.lcc_original: 當那些日子、亞哈隨魯王在書珊宮堡登了國位；
notes: WAH09002+WH03117+WAH01992 (בַּיָּמִים הָהֵם, 'in those days') were all implicit in UNV but explicit in LCC (當那些日子); braces dropped per Rule 3. Following UNV convention that ב-prefix tags attach to the noun rather than to a separate Chinese preposition word: WAH01992→那些 (הָהֵם), and WAH09002+WH03117 both→日子 (יָּמִים), with 當 left unannotated as a Chinese temporal particle.
宮堡 (LCC compound 'palace-fortress') covers Hebrew הַבִּירָה (WH01002); LCC fuses location into a two-character compound where UNV uses two separate words (書珊城 … 宮).

WAH0834 (relative pronoun אֲשֶׁר, 'which') has no explicit LCC equivalent; LCC restructures 'throne of his kingdom, which was in Shushan the citadel' into a plain locative phrase (在書珊宮堡), so WAH0834 is kept implicit as {<WAH0834>} placed after 宮堡.

登 (explicit in LCC, 'ascend/mount') corresponds to implicit שֶׁבֶת (WH03427) + כְּ-prefix (WAH09003) + infinitive-construct morphology (WTH8800) in UNV; braces dropped per Rule 3 and all three tags attached to 登.
了 (Chinese perfective aspect particle) has no Hebrew equivalent and is left unannotated per Rule 5.
國位 covers three Hebrew elements conflated by LCC: עַל (WAH05921, 'upon'), כִּסֵּא (WH03678, 'throne'), and מַלְכוּת (WH04438, 'kingdom'); Rule 6 applied for the multi-SN phrase.

Esth/1.lcc_original: 他執政第三年、曾爲他的衆官長和臣僕擺設了筵席；有波斯和瑪代的權貴各省最顯達的人和官長、在他面前；
notes: 在位 → 執政: UNV uses a nominal phrase 'on the throne'; LCC uses verb 執政 'ruled/governed'; WAH09001+WH04427+WTH8800 attached to 執政 as the head of the temporal clause
米底亞 → 瑪代: Different transliterations of Media (מָדַי WH04074); same referent, straightforward
貴冑 → 最顯達的人: WH06579 (פַּרְתְּמִים, nobles/distinguished) rendered as descriptive phrase in LCC; tag attached to 人 as the head noun
WAH09001+WAH03605 (לְכֹל, for all) attached to 衆 which directly corresponds to כֹּל; the prepositional sense is absorbed into 爲 earlier in LCC
了 after 擺設 is a Chinese perfective aspect particle with no Hebrew equivalent; left unannotated per rule 5
UNV 就是各省的貴冑與首領 restructured in LCC as 各省最顯達的人和官長 without the copular 就是; SNs distributed to corresponding lexemes unchanged

Esth/1.lcc_original: 他把他光榮之國的豐富和他宏大威儀之華貴給他們看了許多日子，共有一百八十天。
notes: 光榮 maps to H03519 (כְּבוֹד), directly corresponding to UNV 榮耀

LCC '宏大威儀之華貴' restructures UNV '美好威嚴的尊貴'; aligned H08597→宏大, H03366→威儀, H01420→華貴 following UNV word order rather than Hebrew order (יְקַר H03366 precedes תִּפְאֶרֶת H08597 in MT); alternative alignment H03366→宏大, H08597→威儀 is plausible
<WAH0853> (accusative אֶת) is implicit in both UNV and LCC since 把 already marks the object; kept in braces both occurrences
LCC 日子 and 天 both receive H03117 (יוֹם) corresponding to UNV 日 in each clause
LCC 共有 is a translator addition with no Hebrew equivalent; left unannotated

Esth/1.lcc_original: 這些日子滿了，王又爲所有在書珊宮堡的衆民、無論尊大卑小、在王宮花園的院子擺設了筵席七天。
notes: UNV {<WH04428>} was implicit (subject 'king' omitted in Chinese); LCC has explicit 王 → dropped braces, attached as 王<WH04428>
LCC 在 maps to UNV 住<WH04672><WTH8737> (Hebrew מָצָא H4672 = found/present; both express location in Shushan)
LCC 宮堡 maps to UNV 城<WH01002> (both = H1002 בִּירָה = palace-fortress/citadel)
UNV {<WH01055>} was implicit (H1055 = בִּיתָן = garden-pavilion); LCC has explicit 宮 in 王宮 → dropped braces, attached as 宮<WH01055>
LCC 尊大/卑小 for UNV 大/小 (H1419/H6996); {<WAH05704>} (H5704 = עַד 'unto') remains implicit between them — LCC encodes the range via 無論...卑小 construction with no single explicit word for 'unto'
LCC word order shifts 衆民 before the 尊大卑小 qualifier (vs UNV 大小人民 order); SNs follow LCC surface order
LCC 天 for UNV 日 at verse end — both = H3117 יוֹם (day)

Esth/1.lcc_original: 有白色綿織的幔子、藍紫色的帷子、用細麻繩子紫紅色繩子、在銀竿【1】上、和白玉石柱上繫起來；有金銀的牀榻擺在斑岩白玉石螺鈿黑玉石的鋪石處。
notes: UNV has three distinct color-fabric terms: 白色(WH02353)、綠色(WH03768)、藍色(WH08504). LCC restructures into two compound descriptions: 白色綿織 merges חוּר (white, WH02353) and כַּרְפַּס (cotton cloth, WH03768) — כַּרְפַּס means fine cloth not 'green', so LCC's 綿織 (woven cotton) is the better semantic target; 藍紫色 receives WH08504 (תְּכֵלֶת = blue-violet).

UNV 環(WH01550=גָּלִיל) → LCC 竿 (rod/pole). גָּלִיל means cylindrical bar or rod, making LCC's 竿 actually a more precise rendering than UNV's 環 (ring); SN transferred to 竿【1】 with footnote marker left in place.

WH08336 (שֵׁשׁ = white marble) in UNV tags the generic noun 玉石 at the end of the stone-type list. In LCC there is no separate generic 'stone' word; שֵׁשׁ is semantically closest to LCC's 白玉石 (white marble). Accordingly WH08336 is co-attached with WH01858 (דַּר) on 白玉石, since both Hebrew terms denote white/lustrous stone and LCC conflates them into one compound.
UNV tags both 白玉石 and 柱 with the same SN WH05982 (עַמּוּד = pillar) in the first clause — likely a FHL encoding of a Hebrew construct chain. Transferred as-is to LCC 白玉石柱.
LCC 繫起來 adds the resultative complement 起來; WH0270 (אָחַז = to fasten) and morphology code WTH8803 (passive participle) are attached to the full verb phrase 繫起來.
UNV 從(WAH05921) expresses the preposition עַל governing the silver rings; LCC rephrases as 在…上. WAH05921 attached to LCC's 在 as the functional equivalent preposition.
LCC 螺鈿 (mother-of-pearl/shell inlay) corresponds to UNV 黃 which carries no SN tag; left unannotated.

Esth/1.lcc_original: 賜飲是用金器皿；器皿和器皿也各不同；御酒很多，按照王的大手面而賜飲。
notes: LCC inverts word order: opens with 賜飲 (verb) before the instrumental phrase; WH08248+WTH8687 attached to the fronted 賜飲, matching Hebrew שָׁקָה. Final 而賜飲 is LCC stylistic resumption with no Hebrew equivalent — left unannotated.

LCC renders Hebrew כֵּלִים מִכֵּלִים ('vessel from vessel') as 器皿和器皿; mapped as 器皿<WH03627>和器皿<WAH04480><WH03627> following the UNV token split where WAH04480 (מִן prefix) + WH03627 attach to the second occurrence.

LCC 按照王的大手面 is an expansive paraphrase of UNV 足顯王的厚意 (= כְּיַד הַמֶּלֶךְ 'according to the hand of the king'); WAH09003 (כְּ prefix) and WH03027 (יָד hand) kept together on 大手面 per UNV prefix-attachment convention; 按照 (rendering the כְּ preposition meaning) left without a separate tag since it is subsumed by WAH09003.
UNV 足顯 has no SN (translational gloss); LCC 按照 similarly unannotated. LCC 很多 = UNV 甚多 = WH07227 (רַב); straightforward.

Esth/1.lcc_original: 喝酒都照定例，沒有勉強人的；因爲王對他宮中的一切臣宰曾立下規矩：人人都要隨己意而行。
notes: UNV {<WAH05921>} was implicit (no explicit Chinese rendering); LCC has 對 explicitly, so braces dropped per Rule 3 — 對<WAH05921> attaches the על preposition to the explicit word.

UNV 吩咐 (commanded) maps to LCC 曾立下規矩 (had established rules); H3245 (יָסַד = to found/establish) supports LCC's rendering; SNs attach after the verb 立下, with 規矩 as the implied object of the founding action.
Two occurrences of WH0376 (אִישׁ וָאִישׁ = each man) map together onto LCC's reduplicated 人人; both SN tags attach to that single word.
WAH09001 (ל infinitive prefix) attaches to 而行 as the infinitive/purpose marker; 而 corresponds to this prefix and 行 = WH06213+WTH8800.
LCC 都 (adverbial 'all/also') in both 都照定例 and 都要 has no direct Hebrew equivalent and is left unannotated per Rule 5.
LCC 照 is treated as the lexical rendering of prefix WAH09003 (כְּ = according to); since WAH09003 is a prefix particle bound to WH01881, both tags are grouped after 定例 as the head noun.

Esth/1.lcc_original: 王后瓦實提也在亞哈隨魯王御殿中爲婦女們擺設了筵席。
notes: 也 (H1571 גַּם) appears earlier in LCC (after 瓦實提) than in UNV (after 宮內); SN attached at its LCC position
LCC 御殿 covers both H1004 (בֵּית palace) and H4438 (מַלְכוּת royal); since 御 explicitly expresses the royal concept, braces dropped for H4438 — both SNs attach to the compound phrase 御殿
H834 (אֲשֶׁר, UNV 的) has no direct lexical correspondent in LCC; the possessive relationship is implicit in phrase order; attached to 御殿 as the modified head noun
LCC 婦女們 adds plural marker 們 (no Hebrew equivalent); H802 attaches to full phrase
LCC reverses UNV's 設擺 to 擺設 and appends aspect particle 了 (no Hebrew equivalent); H6213 and TH8804 attach to 擺設, 了 left unannotated

Esth/1.lcc_original: 第七天亞哈隨魯王因酒而心裏高興，就吩咐伺候他面前的七個太監、米戶幔、比斯他、哈波拿、比革他、亞拔他、西達、甲迦，
notes: 天 (LCC) replaces 日 (UNV) for 'day'; WAH09002+WH03117 attached to 天.
UNV 飲酒 (drinking wine) → LCC 因酒而 (because of wine): WAH09002 (prefix ב) and WH03196 (wine) both attached to 酒, the lexical anchor; 因 and 而 left unannotated as structural particles.
UNV 心中快樂 → LCC 心裏高興: 心裏 receives WH03820 (לֵב), 高興 receives WAH09003+WH02896 (טוֹב with prefix).
WAH0853 (Hebrew direct-object marker אֵת, tagged to UNV 在) has no direct LCC lexical equivalent; attached to 伺候 as head of the serving phrase.
UNV {<WH04428>} is implicit (pronoun-level reference to king); LCC has explicit 他, so braces dropped per Rule 3: 他<WH04428>.
UNV 侍立 → LCC 伺候 (both = 'to serve/wait on'); WH08334+WTH8764 transferred to 伺候.
LCC inserts 、 between 太監 and 米戶幔 (absent in UNV); punctuation preserved, SN assignments unaffected.

Esth/1.lcc_original: 領王后瓦實提戴着王后的冠冕到王面前，使各族之民和大臣看她的美麗；因爲她容貌俊美。
notes: H935 (להביא, to bring) transferred to 領 rather than 到: LCC's 領 is the primary bringing verb; 到 is a directional complement with no independent Hebrew anchor once H935 is on 領.
H853 (object marker אֶת) from UNV's 請 consolidated onto 領: UNV's 請 has no counterpart in LCC, and 領 immediately precedes the direct object 王后瓦實提, the same role 請 played.
LCC word order for 民/大臣 is reversed relative to UNV's 臣民 compound, but matches Hebrew order (הָעַמִּים...וְהַשָּׂרִים = peoples…princes): H5971→民, H8269→大臣.
戴着 left unannotated: it is a Chinese aspect/manner particle (wearing) with no discrete Hebrew equivalent; the crown phrase בְּכֶתֶר מַלְכוּת is fully covered by 王后<WH04438>冠冕<WAH09002><WH03804>.
LCC's 俊美 annotated with H2896 as the equivalent of UNV's 甚美 (both render טוֹבַת).

Esth/1.lcc_original: 王后瓦實提卻不肯遵王由太監經手所傳的命令而來；因此王非常生氣，烈怒中燒。
notes: LCC restructures the eunuch/hand/king/command phrase: UNV順序是 太監(H5631)→所(H834)→傳的(H09002+H3027)→王(H4428)→命(H09002+H1697); LCC reorders to 王→由太監→經手→所→傳的→命令 — mapped 王→WH04428, 太監→WH05631, 經手→WAH09002+WH03027 (=בְּיַד by hand), 所→WAH0834 (=אֲשֶׁר), 命令→WAH09002+WH01697 (=בִּדְבַר command)
{<WH02534>} is implicit in UNV (心 carries the locative WAH09002 only), but LCC has explicit 烈怒 for חֵמָה — dropped braces and attached as 烈怒<WH02534> per rule 3
UNV 心<WAH09002> (locative 'in his heart', בֹו) → LCC 中<WAH09002> (within/in); same locative preposition on a different Chinese word
LCC 由 (Chinese through/by preposition introducing the agent) left unannotated; its semantic role is distributed across surrounding tagged words (太監, 經手)
LCC 傳的 (conveyed) left unannotated; the Hebrew 'by the hand' (בְּיַד) is already tagged on 經手<WAH09002><WH03027>

Esth/1.lcc_original: 那時跟王接近的有甲示拿、示達、押瑪他、他施斯、米力、瑪西拿、米母干、波斯瑪代的七個大臣，都是常見王面、在國中坐首位的人──王問他們說：
notes: claude CLI error:

Esth/3.lcc_original: 哈曼對亞哈隨魯王說：『有一族之民散居在王國內各省各族之民間，而又自己隔開：他們的法例跟各族的法例不同；王的法例他們也不遵行；所以由着他們、對於王最不妥當。
notes: 散居/隔開 split: UNV annotates 散(H6340)居(H6504) as two consecutive characters each with their own SN. LCC uses 散居 as a compound for general scattered-dwelling, then 隔開 as a separate clause. H6340 (פזר=scatter) is attached to 散居, H6504 (פרד=separate) to 隔開 — semantically more accurate in LCC.
LCC adds 各族 twice: first in 各省各族之民間 (second 各族 renders the peoples H5971 = בין העמים), second in 各族的法例 (renders כל-עם H4480+H3605+H5971). Both 各族 instances receive their respective SNs.
WAH0853 (את direct object marker) is kept implicit as {<WAH0853>} after 遵行 — LCC has no explicit particle for the Hebrew definite object marker, consistent with Rule 4.
WAH09001 on 王 in the opening address: the ל prefix (to/for the king) is conveyed by LCC's 對...王 structure; SNs kept on 王 following UNV attachment convention.
LCC's 最不妥當 for UNV 無益: 無(WAH0369)+益(H7737) mapped to 最不(WAH0369)+妥當(H7737+WTH8802). The adverb 最 is a Chinese intensifier with no SN.

Song/1.lcc_original: 哦，願他用他的親嘴使我陶醉哦！因爲你的愛情比酒更好，
notes: LCC restructures the first clause from 'let him kiss me with kisses of his mouth' (Hebrew/UNV) into '願他用他的親嘴使我陶醉'. All five SNs from that clause (WH06310 mouth, WAH04480 מִן-prefix, WH05390 kisses, WH05401 kiss-verb, WTH8799 morphology) are consolidated onto 親嘴, which bridges both the nominal 'kisses of his mouth' and the verbal 'to kiss' concepts in a single pivot word.
UNV marks {<WAH04480>}{<WH05390>} as implicit; LCC 親嘴 explicitly renders 'kisses', so braces are dropped per Rule 3 and tags attached normally.
使我陶醉 ('make me intoxicated') is LCC's interpretive paraphrase of the kissing action with no direct Hebrew equivalent; left unannotated.
哦 exclamation particles are LCC additions with no Hebrew equivalent; left unannotated.
Second clause maps cleanly and directly: 因爲→WAH03588 (כִּי), 愛情→WH01730 (דֹּד), 酒→WAH04480+WH03196 (מִ+יַיִן), 更好→WH02896 (טוֹב).

Song/1.lcc_original: 你的香膏之馨香很美好；你的名如同倒出來的香膏；因此童女們都愛你。
notes: LCC '香膏' corresponds to UNV '膏油' (both = H8081, ointment/oil) — different Chinese terms for the same Hebrew שֶׁמֶן

UNV treats 馨(H2896) and 香(H7381) as two separate annotated characters; LCC uses compound 馨香 for fragrance (→ H7381+WAH09001) while 美好 captures H2896 (טוֹב, good/pleasant); 很 has no Hebrew equivalent and is left unannotated
UNV '所以' → LCC '因此' (both = therefore); WAH05921+WAH03651 (עַל כֵּן) applied to 因此
UNV '眾童女' → LCC '童女們' (H5959, עֲלָמוֹת); plural marker 們 is a Chinese grammatical particle with no separate SN

Song/1.lcc_sn: 願你拉我<WH04900><WTH8798>跟着你<WH0310>哦；我們快跑<WH07323><WTH8799>吧！王<WH04428>帶我進了<WH0935><WTH8689>他的洞房<WH02315>。王阿，我們要因你<WAH09002>而快樂<WH08055><WTH8799>歡喜<WH01523><WTH8799>；我們要頌揚<WH02142><WTH8686>你的愛情<WH01730>，勝過頌揚美酒<WAH04480><WH03196>；稱讚你的愛<WH0157><WTH8804>勝過稱讚新酒<WH04339>。
Song/1.lcc_original: 願你拉我跟着你哦；我們快跑吧！王帶我進了他的洞房。王阿，我們要因你而快樂歡喜；我們要頌揚你的愛情，勝過頌揚美酒；稱讚你的愛勝過稱讚新酒。
Song/1.unv_sn_reference: 願你吸引我<WH04900><WTH8798>，我們就快跑<WH07323><WTH8799>跟隨你<WH0310>。王<WH04428>帶我進了<WH0935><WTH8689>內室<WH02315>，我們必因你<WAH09002>歡喜<WH01523><WTH8799>快樂<WH08055><WTH8799>。我們要稱讚<WH02142><WTH8686>你的愛情<WH01730>，勝似稱讚美酒<WAH04480><WH03196>。他們愛你<WH0157><WTH8804>是理所當然的<WH04339>。
notes: LCC follows Hebrew word order for the opening clause (拉我跟着你快跑), unlike UNV which reorders to 吸引我快跑跟隨你; WH04900 attached to 拉我 (verb+object unit = מָשְׁכֵנִי), WH0310 to 跟着你 (= אַחֲרֶיךָ), WH07323 to 快跑 (= נָּרוּצָה).
LCC reverses rejoicing word order vs UNV: 快樂歡喜 vs UNV 歡喜快樂. Matched to Hebrew roots individually: 快樂 (be glad) = שָׂמַח → WH08055, 歡喜 (rejoice) = גִּיל → WH01523.
Second 王阿 in LCC's rejoicing clause is LCC's vocative addition with no Hebrew parallel; left unannotated.

Final clause is a major restructuring: Hebrew מֵישָׁרִים אֲהֵבוּךָ ('uprightly they love you', WH04339+WH0157) is rendered by LCC as a second wine-comparison clause 稱讚你的愛勝過稱讚新酒 rather than as a direct statement. WH0157+WTH8804 attached to 愛 (the lexical anchor for אהב); WH04339 (מֵישָׁרִים = uprightness/rightly) attached to 新酒 as the closest end-anchor — this is forced since 新酒 has no Hebrew parallel (יַּיִן = wine generically; 新酒 is LCC's literary elaboration).

Song/1.lcc_sn: 耶路撒冷<WH03389>的女子<WH01323>阿，我<WAH0589>雖黝黑<WH07838>，卻很秀美<WH05000>，如同基達<WH06938>的帳棚<WAH09003><WH0168>，如同所羅門<WH08010>的幔子<WAH09003><WH03407>。
Song/1.lcc_original: 耶路撒冷的女子阿，我雖黝黑，卻很秀美，如同基達的帳棚，如同所羅門的幔子。
Song/1.unv_sn_reference: 耶路撒冷<WH03389>的眾女子啊<WH01323>，我<WAH0589>雖然黑<WH07838>，卻是秀美<WH05000>，如同基達<WH06938>的帳棚<WAH09003><WH0168>，好像所羅門<WH08010>的幔子<WAH09003><WH03407>。
notes: WH01323 (בָּנוֹת 'daughters') attaches to content word 女子; the exclamatory particle 阿 is left trailing after the tag rather than before it
UNV 雖然黑 → LCC 雖黝黑; WH07838 placed after 黝黑 which is LCC's fuller rendering of the darkness root
UNV uses 好像 for the second simile; LCC normalizes both to 如同 — alignment is still unambiguous
WAH09003 (כ prefix) is preserved with its head noun (帳棚, 幔子) even though 如同 in LCC already conveys the comparative sense

Song/1.lcc_sn: 你們不要<WAH0408>因我<WAH0589>黝黑<WH07840>，因日頭<WH08121>把我曬黑<WH07805><WTH8804>了、你們就盯着我<WH07200><WTH8799>。我的同母<WH0517>弟兄<WH01121>向我<WAH09002>發怒<WH02787><WTH8738>；他們叫<WH07760><WTH8804>我顧守着<WH05201><WTH8802>{<WAH0853>}葡萄園<WH03754>，我自己的<WAH07945><WAH09001>葡萄園<WH03754>我卻沒有<WAH03808>顧守着<WH05201><WTH8804>呢！
Song/1.lcc_original: 你們不要因我黝黑，因日頭把我曬黑了、你們就盯着我。我的同母弟兄向我發怒；他們叫我顧守着葡萄園，我自己的葡萄園我卻沒有顧守着呢！
notes: WAH0589 (אֲנִי) placement differs from UNV: UNV attaches it to 把我 in the scorching clause, but LCC restructures the verse into two explicit 'because' clauses (因我黝黑 / 因日頭把我曬黑了). WAH0589 is placed on 我 in 因我黝黑, which better matches the Hebrew שֶׁאֲנִי שְׁחַרְחֹרֶת (that I am swarthy).

WH07840 (שְׁחַרְחֹרֶת = swarthy/dark) maps to LCC 黝黑 in the first clause rather than the 黑 in 曬黑了, because LCC expresses the state of being dark (黝黑) and the causative action of scorching (曬黑) in separate clauses.
WH07805+WTH8804 (שָׁזַף = to scorch) annotates the compound resultative verb 曬黑 in 因日頭把我曬黑了; the 黑 component is not separately re-annotated with WH07840 since that SN is already consumed by 黝黑.
LCC 叫 (to tell/cause) corresponds to UNV 使 → both translate Hebrew שִׂים (WH07760, set/make).
LCC 顧守着 (twice) corresponds to UNV 看守 → both translate Hebrew נָטַר (WH05201). First occurrence (participle) takes WTH8802; second (qatal 1cs) takes WTH8804.
{<WAH0853>} (direct object marker אֵת) retained as implicit — Chinese syntax requires no explicit marker.
LCC's repeated 你們 (plural you) and the topicalized second 我 in 我卻沒有顧守着 are Chinese discourse elements with no dedicated Hebrew SN; left unannotated.

Song/1.lcc_original: 我心愛的阿，求你告訴我你在哪裏放羊，你中午在哪裏讓羊躺着休息；我何必在你同伴的羊羣旁像【1】流浪徘徊【1】的女郎呢？
notes: LCC drops the relative particle 所 from 所愛的, so WAH07945 WH0157 WTH8804 all attach after 愛的 as a unit, absorbing the relativizer.
LCC's 讓羊躺着休息 is a periphrastic rendering of H7257 (causative lie-down); all tags attach at clause end as one semantic unit.

LCC's 流浪徘徊的女郎 is a substantial interpretive departure from UNV's 蒙著臉的人 (veiled person); both render H5844 (עָטָה, to wrap/veil), but LCC follows a tradition that reads it as a wandering woman — WAH09003 WH05844 WTH8802 are all appended after 女郎 as the phrase-final position.
Footnote markers 【1】 within LCC are preserved exactly per rule 7.
Second 哪裏 receives WH0349 (no prefix, matching UNV's bare 何處<WH0349>); first 哪裏 receives WAH0349 (with prefix, matching UNV's 何處<WAH0349>).

Song/1.lcc_original: 你這女子中極美麗的阿，你若不知道，只管出去，跟着羊羣的腳蹤走，把你的山羊羔在牧人帳幕旁放放。
notes: LCC adds vocative particle 阿 after 極美麗的 — left unannotated as it has no Hebrew equivalent.

LCC restructures the 'go-out/follow-footsteps' clause: UNV has 跟隨...腳蹤...去 (follow...footsteps...go), while LCC has 出去...跟着...腳蹤...走. H3318 (יָצָא, go out) maps to 出去; 走 is unannotated as it functions as a connective gloss with no unaccounted Hebrew source.
{<WAH09001>} retained as implicit after 出去 — the ethical dative לָכְ is unexpressed in LCC just as in UNV.
H7462 appears twice: once as Qal participle on 牧人 (<WTH8802>), once as Qal imperative on 放放 (<WTH8798>). LCC uses the reduplicated form 放放 for the verb; tags attach to the full reduplication.
LCC uses 帳幕 (tent/tabernacle) where UNV has 帳棚; both map to H4908 (מִשְׁכָּן).

Isa/1.lcc_sn: 以下是亞摩斯<WH0531>的兒子<WH01121>以賽亞<WH03470>的異象<WH02377>，就是當猶大<WH03063>王<WH04428>烏西雅<WH05818>、約坦<WH03147>、亞哈斯<WH0271>、希西家<WH03169>執政的日子<WAH09002><WH03117>以賽亞所<WAH0834>看見<WH02372><WTH8804>、論到<WAH05921>猶大<WH03063>和耶路撒冷<WH03389>的。
Isa/1.lcc_original: 以下是亞摩斯的兒子以賽亞的異象，就是當猶大王烏西雅、約坦、亞哈斯、希西家執政的日子以賽亞所看見、論到猶大和耶路撒冷的。
notes: LCC restructures from UNV's verb-object clause (得<WH02372>默示<WH02377>) into a topic-comment noun phrase (異象<WH02377>…所看見<WH02372>), so the tags split across two positions: 異象 gets WH02377, 看見 gets WH02372+WTH8804.
所 in '所看見' is treated as an explicit Chinese relativizer for אֲשֶׁר ({<WAH0834>} in UNV); per Rule 3 the braces are dropped and the tag attaches after 所.

The second occurrence of 以賽亞 ('以賽亞所看見') is left unannotated: LCC restates the subject explicitly for the relative clause, whereas Hebrew uses only the implicit pronoun in חָזָה (he saw). WH03470 is already assigned to the first 以賽亞.
執政 (to govern/reign) is LCC's added verbal predicate making the temporal clause grammatical; UNV's equivalent 作 is likewise unannotated in the source, so no SN is assigned.
日子<WAH09002><WH03117> maps cleanly to UNV 時候<WAH09002><WH03117> — both render Hebrew בִּימֵי (in the days of).

Isa/1.lcc_original: 天哪，要聽！地阿，要側耳以聽！因爲永恆主說：『我將兒女養大，撫養起來，他們竟背叛了我。
notes: 永恆主 (Eternal Lord) tagged with WH03068 (Yahweh); LCC consistently renders the Tetragrammaton as 永恆主 rather than 耶和華

UNV 養育(WH01431/gadal)+養大(WH07311/rum) maps to LCC 養大+撫養起來 in arguably reversed order; aligned WH01431(gadal=cause to grow/be great) to 養大 and WH07311(rum=lift up/exalt, supported by 起來) to 撫養起來; this order inversion is the main source of reduced confidence
了 (Chinese perfective aspect particle) before 我 left unannotated; WAH09002 attached to 我 only
WTH8765 appears on both 說(WH01696) and 養大(WH01431) — correct, same morphology code for two separate verbs

Isa/1.lcc_original: 牛認識牛主，驢認識牠主人的槽；以色列卻不認識，我的人民總不細想。』
notes: UNV 主人<WH07069> (H7069 qanah=buyer/owner) → LCC 牛主; LCC disambiguates the referent by prepending 牛, tag placed after 牛主 as the full phrase.
UNV 主人<WH01167> (H1167 ba'al=master) → LCC 牠主人; LCC adds the pronoun 牠 (its) before 主人, tag placed after 主人.
Second 認識 (donkey clause) carries no SN in UNV because the Hebrew verb יָדַע is elided—only appears once governing both clauses. LCC's second 認識 is likewise left untagged.
UNV 卻不<WAH03808> (second negation) → LCC 總不; different adverb but semantically the same negation particle, WAH prefix preserved.
UNV 留意<WH0995><WTH8712> (H995 hithpolel hitbonen=reflect/consider) → LCC 細想; 細想 (carefully think) is a good functional equivalent; morphology tag <WTH8712> for hithpolel attached accordingly.

Isa/1.lcc_original: 嗐，犯罪的國，罪孽沉重的人民，作壞事的種，敗壞的兒女！他們離棄了永恆主，藐視以色列之聖者，跟他疏遠。
notes: 國民 (UNV, WH01471) → 國 (LCC): LCC abbreviates to 國 alone; SN attached to 國
擔著 (WH03515) + 罪孽 (WH05771) + 百姓 (WH05971): LCC reorders to 罪孽沉重的人民; tagged in LCC word order as 罪孽<WH05771>沉重<WH03515>的人民<WH05971>
行惡的 (WH07489+WTH8688) → 作壞事的: different phrasing for same Hebrew root רעע; morphology code follows its verb
耶和華 (WH03068) → 永恆主: standard LCC rendering of יהוה
了 (aspect particle after 離棄) has no Hebrew equivalent; left unannotated per Rule 5
與他生疏 (WH02114+WTH8738) + 往後退步 (WH0268): LCC merges both Hebrew elements into 跟他疏遠; all three tags attached to 疏遠 as the covering phrase
{<WH0853>} kept implicit for both object-marker occurrences: LCC has no explicit accusative particle

Jer/1.lcc_original: 便雅憫地亞拿突城的祭司中、希勒家的兒子耶利米、的言行記在下面。
notes: LCC uses 言行 (words and deeds) where UNV uses 話 (words); both correspond to <WH01697> (דָּבָר). LCC's rendering is slightly broader but this is clearly the same referent.
LCC punctuation (、instead of ，) preserved exactly from source.
All nine SNs map cleanly to the same lexical positions in LCC — the two versions are structurally near-identical for this verse.

Jer/1.lcc_original: 當猶大王亞們的兒子約西亞的日子，他執政的十三年那時候，永恆主的話傳與耶利米。
notes: UNV {<WAH09002>}{<WH03117>} are both implicit (Hebrew בִּימֵי = ב+יְמֵי); LCC has explicit 當 (preposition 'in/when') and 日子 ('days'), so per Rule 3 braces are dropped: <WAH09002> attaches to 當 and <WH03117> to 日子.
LCC 永恆主 (Everlasting Lord) is LCC's systematic rendering of יְהוָה in place of UNV 耶和華; same referent, H03068 assigned confidently.
LCC 執政 ('govern/rule') maps to UNV 在位 (H04427 מָלַךְ 'reign'); 他 is a LCC-added explicit subject pronoun with no Hebrew equivalent, left unannotated.
LCC 傳與 maps to UNV 臨到: 傳 takes <WAH01961> (H01961 הָיָה 'come') and 與 takes <WAH0413> (H0413 אֶל 'to') — LCC uses different verbs but same semantic mapping.

UNV {<WAH0834>} (H0834 אֲשֶׁר 'which/that', a relative clause connector) is kept implicit {<WAH0834>} in LCC; 那時候 ('at that time') is a LCC paraphrase of the clause structure rather than a direct translation of אֲשֶׁר.
耶利米 carries no SN in the UNV source; left unannotated in LCC.

Jer/1.lcc_original: 當猶大王約西亞的兒子約雅敬的日子，直到猶大王約西亞的兒子西底家十一年年底，直到五月間耶路撒冷人流亡的時候，永恆主的話都常常傳與耶利米。
Jer/1.unv_sn_reference: 從猶大<WH03063>王<WH04428>約西亞<WH02977>的兒子<WH01121>約雅敬<WH03079>在位的時候<WAH09002><WH03117>，直到<WAH05704>猶大<WH03063>王<WH04428>約西亞<WH02977>的兒子<WH01121>西底家<WAH09001><WH06667>在位的末年<WH08552><WTH8800>，就是{<WAH05704>}十一<WH06249><WH06240>年<WH08141>五<WH02549>月間<WAH09002><WH02320>耶路撒冷<WH03389>人被擄<WH01540><WTH8800>的時候，耶和華的話也常臨到<WAH01961>耶利米。
notes: UNV '在位的時候'+<WAH09002><WH03117> → LCC '的日子': 日子 corresponds to WH03117 (יוֹם = day/time); ב-prefix (WAH09002) attaches to it as a unit.
UNV order is '在位的末年'<WH08552><WTH8800> then '十一年'; LCC reverses to '十一年年底' — WH08552+WTH8800 placed on 年底 after 十一年<WH08141>.
Implicit {<WAH05704>} in UNV ('就是{<WAH05704>}') maps to the second explicit 直到 in LCC; Rule 3 applied — braces dropped, tag attached as normal.
UNV '被擄'<WH01540><WTH8800> → LCC '流亡': different gloss but same Hebrew root גָּלָה (WH01540); morphology WTH8800 follows.
UNV '耶和華' carries no explicit SN in the supplied UNV+SN text; LCC '永恆主' (YHWH rendering) is left unannotated accordingly.
<WAH01961> (וַיְהִי, 'and it came/was') attaches to LCC '傳與' as the main verb of the clause, corresponding to UNV '臨到'.
UNV opens with 耶利米說， (no SN) which LCC omits entirely — no alignment needed
永恆主 (Eternal Lord) = 耶和華 → H3068 (YHWH); LCC uses a paraphrastic rendering but the referent is identical
傳 (transmit/convey) aligns with 臨 (come upon) for H1961 (היה); LCC softens the directional nuance but the semantic slot is the same
與我 aligns with 到我 for WAH0413 (אֶל + suffix); SN placed after 我 to keep the comma in its original position before 說

Lam/1.lcc_sn: 怎麼啦<WAH0349>！先前滿有<WH07227>人民<WH05971>的城<WH05892>，現在竟自獨<WH0910>坐<WH03427><WTH8804>阿！先前在列國中<WAH09002><WH01471>爲大的<WH07227>，現在竟{<WAH01961>}如寡婦<WAH09003><WH0490>阿！先前在諸省中<WAH09002><WH04082>爲王后<WH08282>的，現在竟成了<WAH01961>作苦工的<WAH09001><WH04522>阿！
Lam/1.lcc_original: 怎麼啦！先前滿有人民的城，現在竟自獨坐阿！先前在列國中爲大的，現在竟如寡婦阿！先前在諸省中爲王后的，現在竟成了作苦工的阿！
Lam/1.unv_sn_reference: 先前滿有<WH07227>人民<WH05971>的城<WH05892>，現在何竟<WAH0349>獨<WH0910>坐<WH03427><WTH8804>！先前在列國中<WAH09002><WH01471>為大的<WH07227>，現在竟{<WAH01961>}如寡婦<WAH09003><WH0490>；先前在諸省中<WAH09002><WH04082>為王后<WH08282>的，現在成為<WAH01961>進貢的<WAH09001><WH04522>。
notes: WAH0349 (אֵיכָה): UNV positions '何竟' mid-sentence; LCC repositions to sentence-initial '怎麼啦！' — same lexeme, different syntactic slot; tagged after 怎麼啦.
{WAH01961} clause 2: LCC '現在竟如寡婦' has no explicit copula/verb; implicit braces retained.
WAH01961 clause 3: LCC uses explicit '成了' for היה — braces dropped, tag attached directly after 成了.
WAH09001+WH04522 (לְמַס = tribute/forced labor): LCC '作苦工的' is a paraphrase of UNV '進貢的'; both render מַס; tags attached after the full phrase.
LCC '自' in '竟自獨坐' is a Chinese reflexive/emphatic particle with no Hebrew correspondent — left unannotated.
Clause-final '阿！' is a Chinese exclamatory particle — no Hebrew equivalent, unannotated.

Lam/1.lcc_original: 她夜間痛哭，淚水滿腮；在她衆親愛者中間、沒一個安慰她的；她的朋友都以詭詐待她，成爲她的仇敵。
notes: LCC 痛哭 is a single compound verb where UNV splits it into 痛 (Qal inf.abs., WTH8800) + 哭 (Qal impf., WTH8799); both H01058 instances with their morphology codes are attached together to 痛哭 to represent the Hebrew emphatic בָּכֹה תִּבְכֶּה construction.
LCC 淚水 corresponds to UNV 淚 (H01832); the added 水 is an LCC explanatory expansion and left unannotated.
UNV 流滿<WAH05921> (= Hebrew עַל 'upon') rendered as LCC 滿<WAH05921>; the 流 in UNV has no LCC equivalent and disappears.

LCC 衆 corresponds to UNV 一切 (= Hebrew כָּל); both WAH04480 (מ prefix = 'from/among') and WAH03605 are placed on 衆. The preceding 在 is a translation artifact (unannotated) and 她 before 衆親愛者 is the possessive suffix embedded in H0157 (unannotated).
LCC ends first main clause with ；where UNV uses 。; LCC original punctuation preserved exactly throughout.

Lam/1.lcc_original: 猶大因遭遇苦難，又因多作苦工，就流亡外邦；她住在列國中，尋不着安居之地；追逼她的、都在她困苦時將她追上。
notes: 服勞苦 (UNV) → 作苦工 (LCC): different phrasings for עֲבֹדָה (H05656, labour/service); SN placed after LCC's 作苦工.
遷到外邦 (UNV) → 流亡外邦 (LCC): both render גָּלָה (H01540, to go into exile); morphology <WTH8804> follows.
安息 (UNV) → 安居之地 (LCC): both render מָנוֹחַ (H04494, resting-place); LCC is more expansive but the SN follows the whole phrase.

在…狹窄之地 (UNV) → 在她困苦時 (LCC): בֵּין הַמְּצָרִים rendered spatially in UNV but temporally ('time of distress') in LCC. <WAH0996> (בֵּין) placed after 在; <WH04712> (מֵצַר) after 困苦時. LCC's 她 is an addition with no Hebrew correspondent and is left unannotated.
LCC punctuation (commas, semicolons, 、) preserved exactly from source; only SN tags inserted.

Ezek/1.lcc_original: 第三十年四月初五日、我在迦巴魯河邊流亡人之中，天開了，我看見關於上帝的異象。
notes: <WAH01961> (וַיְהִי 'and it came to pass') has no explicit word in LCC — kept as braced implicit {<WAH01961>} at the head of the verse
UNV parenthetical 以西結（原文是我<WAH0589>）signals the Hebrew has אֲנִי (I); LCC drops the parenthetical and uses 我 directly — <WAH0589> attached to first 我
UNV 被擄的人 (captives/exiles) maps to LCC 流亡人 (wandering exiles); <WH01473> attached to 流亡人
LCC 之中 covers UNV 中 for H08432 תּוֹךְ (midst); <WAH09002><WH08432> attached to 之中
UNV 得見 (Hiphil perception verb) maps to LCC 看見; <WH07200><WTH8799> attached to 看見
UNV 神 → LCC 上帝 (systematic difference for H0430 אֱלֹהִים); <WH0430> attached to 上帝
LCC 關於 (concerning, linking 看見 to 上帝的異象) is a Chinese syntactic addition with no direct Hebrew equivalent — left unannotated
第 (Chinese ordinal marker before 三十) has no Hebrew equivalent — left unannotated

Ezek/1.lcc_original: 當約雅斤王流亡了去的第五年、四月初五日、
notes: WAH01931 (הִיא, copular pronoun 'it/that'): UNV renders as 正是 (it is/that is); LCC restructures as temporal clause with 當 — no direct translation of הִיא — attached to 當 as the nearest structural anchor for this clause-marker

WH01546 (גָּלוּת, exile/captivity): UNV 被擄 → LCC 流亡; both SNs (WAH09001 prefix + WH01546) attach to 流亡 as the main exile word; 了、去、的 are Chinese grammatical particles with no Hebrew equivalent and left unannotated
Date formula (四月初五日) maps cleanly: WAH09001+WH02320 to 四月, WAH09002+WH02568 to 初五; 日 has no separate SN in UNV and is left bare in LCC

Ezek/1.lcc_original: 在迦勒底人之地迦巴魯河邊、永恆主的話特特地傳與布西的兒子祭司以西結；永恆主的手就在那裏按在他【1】身上。
notes: LCC uses 永恆主 instead of 耶和華 for יְהוָה (WH03068); tag placed after 永恆主 both times.
UNV translates יַד (WH03027) as 靈 (Spirit) with a footnote saying the Hebrew says 手; LCC directly uses 手, so tag attaches cleanly to 手.
LCC 按 (press/rest upon) corresponds to UNV 降 (fell/came upon) — both represent the Hebrew וַתְּהִי (WAH01961); tagged accordingly.
{<WAH05921>} kept implicit between 之地 and 迦巴魯 because LCC also lacks an explicit preposition particle there, matching UNV's implicit treatment.
那裏 in LCC is an explicit word for the implicit {<WAH08033>} שָׁם (there); braces dropped per Rule 3.
特特地傳與 split as 特特地<WAH01961>傳<WAH01961>與<WAH0413>, mirroring UNV's 特特<WAH01961>臨<WAH01961>到<WAH0413> (infinitive absolute + finite verb + preposition).

Dan/1.lcc_original: 猶大王約雅敬執掌國政之第三年、巴比倫王尼布甲尼撒來到耶路撒冷，將耶路撒冷圍困住。
notes: UNV 在位 (H04438 מַלְכוּת + 09001 בְּ prefix) → LCC 執掌國政之: LCC freely expands 'in the kingdom/reign of' into 'managing the affairs of state'; both SNs attached after 執掌國政之 as the phrase boundary.
UNV 城 (<WAH05921> עַל = against the city) → LCC uses 耶路撒冷 explicitly in the siege clause instead of pronoun/city; <WAH05921> attached after the second 耶路撒冷.
LCC adds 住 (resultative complement marking completion of the siege action) with no Hebrew equivalent — left unannotated per rule 5.

Hos/1.lcc_sn: 以下是永恆主<WH03068>的話<WH01697>，就是當烏西雅<WH05818>、約坦<WH03147>、亞哈斯<WH0271>、希西家<WH03169>做猶大<WH03063>王<WH04428>的日子<WAH09002><WH03117>，也是當約阿施<WH03101>的兒子<WH01121>耶羅波安<WH03379>做以色列<WH03478>王<WH04428>的日子{<WAH0834>}、傳<WAH01961>與<WAH0413>備利<WH0882>的兒子<WH01121>何西阿<WH01954>的。
Hos/1.lcc_original: 以下是永恆主的話，就是當烏西雅、約坦、亞哈斯、希西家做猶大王的日子，也是當約阿施的兒子耶羅波安做以色列王的日子、傳與備利的兒子何西阿的。
notes: LCC's opening phrase '以下是' is an editorial introduction with no Hebrew equivalent; left unannotated.
'永恆主' is LCC's rendering of יְהוָה (YHWH); tagged <WH03068>.

The two occurrences of בִּימֵי (WAH09002+WH03117) are placed on the two '日子' nouns rather than on '當', since '日子' carries the semantic weight of the noun 'days' and '當' is LCC's Chinese temporal conjunction with no independent Hebrew lexeme.
The relative particle {<WAH0834>} is kept implicit (braces retained); LCC's nominalized sentence-final '的' absorbs the relative clause structurally with no single explicit word to attach the tag to.

LCC's '傳' (transmit/give) maps to Hebrew הָיָה <WAH01961> ('came/was'); '與' maps to Hebrew אֶל <WAH0413> ('to/unto'). LCC renders the arrival of the word more dynamically than UNV's '臨到' but the two-word split is preserved.
Missing SNs: 03117, 09002

Hos/1.lcc_original: 永恆主開始同何西阿講話，對何西阿說：『你去，娶淫婦爲妻，收取淫亂生的兒女；因爲這地大行淫亂、離棄了永恆主。』
notes: 耶和華 (WH03068) → 永恆主: LCC systematically uses 永恆主 for the Tetragrammaton; both occurrences annotated.
UNV 他<WH01954> (pronoun) → LCC 何西阿 (explicit name in second clause): WH01954 transferred to the full name.
{<WH03068>} kept implicit: LCC second clause '對何西阿說' also has no explicit subject, so the implicit brace form is retained.

Hebrew infinitive absolute construction (זָנֹה תִזְנֶה): UNV splits as 大<WH02181><WTH8800>行淫亂<WH02181><WTH8799>; LCC 大行淫亂 follows the same split to preserve distinct morphology codes (8800=inf.abs., 8799=qal impf.).
收取 receives no SN, following UNV where the parallel 也收 is also unannotated; H03947 (לֵקַח) is assigned only to 娶 in both versions.
離棄了: aspect particle 了 is a Chinese addition with no Hebrew counterpart and is left unannotated after 離棄<WH0310>.

Hos/1.lcc_original: 於是何西阿就去、娶了滴拉音的女兒歌篾；這婦人懷了孕，給他生個兒子。
notes: UNV 懷孕 → LCC 懷了孕 (aspect particle 了 inserted between verb and object); SN attached after 孕 as the semantic head
UNV 生了一個兒子 → LCC 生個兒子; 了 and 一 are absent in LCC — both are unannotated function words anyway; 兒子 carries <WH01121>
{<WAH0853>} kept implicit: LCC has no explicit direct-object marker corresponding to Hebrew את

Hos/1.lcc_original: 永恆主對何西阿說：『給他起名叫耶斯列【1】，因爲再過片時、我必向耶戶家追討在耶斯列殺人流血的罪，也必使以色列家的國滅絕。
notes: 耶和華 (UNV) → 永恆主 (LCC): both render יהוה (WH03068); Lü's characteristic rendering of the divine name
{<WAH05921>} was implicit in UNV (no explicit character for עַל), but LCC has explicit 向 ('against/toward'); braces dropped per Rule 3 and tag attached to 向
UNV 討<WH06485><WTH8804> → LCC 追討<WH06485><WTH8804>: LCC uses compound verb 追討 to render פקד; both morphology tags attach to the compound
LCC clause order is 向耶戶家追討 vs UNV 討{upon}耶戶家 — SNs placed at semantically correct positions despite reordering
{<WAH0853>} (direct object marker את) has no explicit LCC word; kept as implicit per Rule 4
Footnote marker 【1】 preserved in its original position after SN insertion on 耶斯列

Joel/1.lcc_sn: 永恆主<WH03068>的話<WH01697>、傳與<WAH0834><WAH01961><WAH0413>毘土珥<WH06602>的兒子<WH01121>約珥<WH03100>的、記在下面。
Joel/1.lcc_original: 永恆主的話、傳與毘土珥的兒子約珥的、記在下面。
notes: 永恆主 is LCC's rendering of יְהוָה (H3068), equivalent to UNV's 耶和華.

LCC's 傳與 compresses three Hebrew tokens into one compound verb: אֲשֶׁר (H0834, implicit in UNV), הָיָה (H1961), and אֶל (H0413). Per rule 3, H0834 braces are dropped because LCC has an explicit word (傳) for the relative clause sense.
LCC's 的 after 約珥 is a structural genitive particle with no Hebrew equivalent; left unannotated.
LCC's 記在下面 is Lü's interpretive addition (not in the Hebrew); left unannotated.

Joel/1.lcc_sn: 老年人<WH02205>哪，要聽<WH08085><WTH8798>這話<WAH02063>，國中<WH0776>所有<WAH03605>的居民<WH03427><WTH8802>哪，要側耳以聽<WH0238><WTH8685>！在你們的日子<WAH09002><WH03117>、或<WH0518>你們列祖<WH01>的日子<WAH09002><WH03117>、曾有<WAH01961>過以下這樣的事<WAH02063>麼？
Joel/1.lcc_original: 老年人哪，要聽這話，國中所有的居民哪，要側耳以聽！在你們的日子、或你們列祖的日子、曾有過以下這樣的事麼？
Joel/1.unv_sn_reference: 老年人哪<WH02205>，當聽<WH08085><WTH8798>我的話{<WAH02063>}；國中<WH0776>的居民<WH03427><WTH8802>哪，都<WAH03605>要側耳而聽<WH0238><WTH8685>。在你們的日子<WAH09002><WH03117>，或<WH0518>你們列祖<WH01>的日子<WAH09002><WH03117>，曾有<WAH01961>這樣的事<WAH02063>嗎？
notes: UNV '我的話{<WAH02063>}' is implicit; LCC makes it explicit as '這話' — dropped braces and attached normally per rule 3
UNV '都<WAH03605>' appears after the verb clause; LCC repositions it as '所有<WAH03605>' within the noun phrase before '居民', which actually better reflects Hebrew כֹּל יֹשְׁבֵי הָאָרֶץ word order
LCC adds aspect particle '過' after '曾有' — no Hebrew equivalent, left unannotated
LCC adds '以下' before '這樣的事' — translator's clarifying addition with no Hebrew equivalent; SN WAH02063 attaches to '事' at end of phrase

Joel/1.lcc_sn: 要將這事向<WAH05921>你們的子孫<WAH09001><WH01121>傳說<WH05608><WTH8761>，讓你們的子孫<WH01121>傳與他們的子孫<WAH09001><WH01121>，而他們的子孫<WH01121>又傳與另<WH0312>一代<WAH09001><WH01755>。
Joel/1.lcc_original: 要將這事向你們的子孫傳說，讓你們的子孫傳與他們的子孫，而他們的子孫又傳與另一代。
notes: H5921 (עָלֶיהָ, 'about it') is implicit {<WAH05921>} in UNV because no Chinese word renders it; LCC has explicit 向, so braces dropped per Rule 3 and SN attached to 向

LCC collapses UNV's generational distinction (子 H1121 = sons, 孫 H1121 = grandsons) into the single compound 子孫 (descendants); both levels map to the same Hebrew H1121 so SN content is preserved, but the four H1121 tags must be distributed across three 子孫 occurrences following the clause structure: object of 1st clause gets WAH09001+H1121 (the ו-prefixed form), subject of 2nd gets H1121, object of 2nd gets WAH09001+H1121, subject of 3rd gets H1121
LCC's 一 in 另一代 has no Hebrew counterpart—Hebrew is simply דּוֹר אַחֵר (another generation) with no numeral—left unannotated per Rule 5
LCC's structural particles 讓 and 而 and adverb 又 are Chinese clause-chaining devices with no Hebrew equivalent and are left unannotated per Rule 5

Obad/1.lcc_original: 俄巴底亞所見的異象。我們從永恆主那裏聽到了信息，同時有使節奉差在列國中，說：『起來！我們起來作戰、攻擊以東吧！』【1】論以到東、主永恆主是這麼說的【1】：
notes: UNV places WH0136+WH03069 (Adonai+YHWH) on 耶和華 in the superscription title; LCC's title 俄巴底亞所見的異象 has no LORD reference, so these SNs are applied to 主永恆主 in the footnote clause corresponding to Hebrew כֹּה אָמַר אֲדֹנָי יְהוִה לֶאֱדוֹם

LCC 攻擊以東 rearranges UNV 與以東爭戰 (fight against Edom); WH05921 (עַל, against) applied to 以東 as the final word of the phrase expressing עָלֶיהָ (against her = Edom), with 作戰 carrying WAH09001+WH04421 for לַמִּלְחָמָה
以到東 in the LCC footnote appears to be a textual error for 以東; SNs WAH09001+WH0123 applied to it as-is per original text preservation rule
LCC 所見的 (relative clause marker for 'seen by'), introductory 說 before the quote, 同時, 有, 在, 中, and aspect particle 了 have no direct Hebrew equivalents and are left unannotated
LCC uses plural 我們 (we) in both the message body and the cohortative, correctly reflecting Hebrew שָׁמַעְנוּ and וְנָקוּמָה; UNV uses singular 我 — both pronouns left unannotated

Jonah/1.lcc_original: 永恆主的話傳與亞米太的兒子約拿、說：
notes: 耶和華 (H3068) → 永恆主: LCC's standard rendering of the Tetragrammaton as 永恆主 ('Eternal Lord') rather than the transliterated 耶和華.
臨<WAH01961>到<WAH0413> → 傳<WAH01961>與<WAH0413>: UNV splits the verbal idea across two tokens; LCC parallels this with 傳 ('transmitted/came') + 與 ('to/unto'). H1961 attaches to 傳, H413 attaches to 與.
LCC uses ideographic enumeration comma 、 where UNV uses ，; punctuation preserved exactly as-is in LCC original.

Jonah/1.lcc_original: 『你起來，往尼尼微那大城去，宣告警戒它的居民；因爲他們的壞行爲上到我面前了。』
notes: UNV '向<WAH05921>…呼喊<WH07121><WTH8798>' (call out against) → LCC '宣告警戒'; LCC has no separate preposition word for עַל, so <WAH05921> and <WH07121><WTH8798> are both attached to 宣告警戒 as the full verb phrase covers both the calling and its directional sense
UNV '惡<WH07451>' (רַע, evil/wickedness) → LCC '壞行爲' (bad deeds); H7451 attached to the full two-character phrase
UNV '達到<WH05927><WTH8804>' → LCC '上到<WH05927><WTH8804>'; H5927 (עָלָה, to ascend/go up) is actually a stronger semantic match for LCC's 上到 than UNV's 達到
LCC 那 (demonstrative before 大城) has no UNV or Hebrew counterpart; left unannotated
LCC final aspect particle 了 has no Hebrew equivalent; left unannotated

Jonah/1.lcc_original: 但是約拿卻起來，逃往他施去避永恆主的面；他下到約帕，遇見了一隻船要往他施；他給了船費，就下船，要和他們同往他施、去避永恆主的面。
notes: LCC opens with 但是 (discourse connector absent from Hebrew); left unannotated
永恆主 receives WH03068 — LCC's standard rendering of יְהוָה (UNV 耶和華)

UNV bundles WAH04480+WAH09001+WH06440 together on 躲避; LCC makes 的面 (face, פָּנִים) explicit, so WH06440 is split onto 面 while WAH04480+WAH09001 remain on 避 as the preposition complex מִלִּ (from-before)
LCC 船費 vs UNV 船價 for WH07939 (שָׂכָר hire/fare) — different word choice, same semantic
UNV uses idiomatic 上了 ('board') while LCC uses literal 下 ('go down', matching Hebrew יָרַד); both tagged WH03381+WTH8799
LCC 他們 makes the implicit antecedent of UNV 船上的人 explicit — left unannotated; WAH05973 (עִם with/together) placed on 同 following UNV convention
Aspect particle 了 (after 遇見) and discourse particle 就 carry no Hebrew equivalent — unannotated

Mic/1.lcc_sn: 以下是永恆主<WH03068>的話<WH01697>，就是當猶大<WH03063>王<WH04428>約坦<WH03147>、亞哈斯<WH0271>、希西家<WH03169>執政的日子<WAH09002><WH03117>傳與<WAH0413>摩利沙人<WH04183>彌迦<WH04318>的；{<WAH0834>}是彌迦見<WH02372><WTH8804>了異象論<WAH05921>到撒瑪利亞<WH08111>和耶路撒冷<WH03389>所說的。
Mic/1.lcc_original: 以下是永恆主的話，就是當猶大王約坦、亞哈斯、希西家執政的日子傳與摩利沙人彌迦的；是彌迦見了異象論到撒瑪利亞和耶路撒冷所說的。
notes: LCC opens with introductory phrase '以下是' and repositions '永恆主的話' (LORD's word) to sentence-initial position, mirroring Hebrew syntax more closely than UNV; 永恆主 annotated WH03068, 話 annotated WH01697.
LCC '執政' (to govern/reign) has no direct Hebrew SN counterpart — unannotated; '日子' carries WH03117 (יוֹם, day) and WAH09002 (בְּ prefix) for בִּימֵי.
Implicit {WAH0413} (אֶל, 'to') is explicitly expressed in LCC by '與' in the compound 傳與; braces dropped per Rule 3 and tag attached after 傳與.

Implicit {WAH0834} (second אֲשֶׁר, relative pronoun) kept implicit and placed at the clause boundary before '是彌迦見了異象'; LCC uses a 是…所說的 cleft construction rather than a direct relative pronoun, so no single lexical equivalent exists.
WH02372 + WTH8804 (חָזָה qal perfect, 'saw/envisioned') maps to LCC '見'; '了' (aspect particle) and '異象' (vision, explication of the verb's meaning) are LCC additions and left unannotated.
Second occurrence of '彌迦' in LCC ('是彌迦見了異象') makes explicit the implicit Hebrew subject of חָזָה ('he saw'); left unannotated as it has no separate Hebrew word.
LCC uses '撒瑪利亞' vs UNV '撒馬利亞' — alternate transliteration of שֹׁמְרוֹן; same referent, WH08111 applied.

Nah/1.lcc_sn: 以下是關於尼尼微<WH05210>的神託<WH04853>，是伊勒歌斯人<WH0512>那鴻<WH05151>的異象<WH02377>書<WH05612>。
Nah/1.lcc_original: 以下是關於尼尼微的神託，是伊勒歌斯人那鴻的異象書。
Nah/1.unv_sn_reference: 論尼尼微<WH05210>的默示<WH04853>，就是伊勒歌斯人<WH0512>那鴻<WH05151>所得的默示{<WH05612>}<WH02377>。
notes: 神託 (LCC) maps to 默示 (UNV) for WH04853 (מַשָּׂא, burden/oracle) — different translation choice but clear semantic correspondence
UNV's {<WH05612>} (implicit סֵפֶר, book) becomes explicit 書 in LCC; braces dropped per Rule 3 and tag attached to 書
LCC's introductory phrase 以下是 and structural particles 關於/是/的 have no direct Hebrew equivalents and are left unannotated
異象<WH02377>書<WH05612> preserves LCC word order while correctly distributing חָזוֹן (vision) and סֵפֶר (book)

Nah/1.lcc_original: 【1】永恆主是忌邪、是行報應的上帝；永恆主施行着報應，而且滿有烈怒。【2】永恆主向他的敵人行報應，他向他的仇敵懷怒【2】。
notes: 耶和華→永恆主 and 神→上帝 are systematic LCC substitutions throughout the OT
{<WH03068>} implicit in UNV but LCC has explicit 永恆主 in clause 3 — braces dropped per rule 3
{<WAH01931>} implicit in UNV but LCC has explicit 他 — braces dropped per rule 3
H01167 (ba'al = possessor/owner) + H02534 (chemah = wrath): UNV renders 大有忿怒, LCC renders 滿有烈怒; split as 滿有<WH01167> and 烈怒<WH02534>
H05358 (take vengeance) appears three times; LCC lexicalizes it differently each time (行報應, 施行着報應, 行報應) but the SN mapping is unambiguous
WTH8802 on H0341 (אֹיֵב = Qal active participle 'enemy') retained on 仇敵 as in UNV
LCC footnote markers 【1】【2】 preserved in original positions without SN annotation

Hab/1.lcc_sn: 神言人<WH05030>哈巴谷<WH02265>在異象中所<WAH0834>見<WH02372><WTH8804>的神託<WH04853>：他說：
Hab/1.lcc_original: 神言人哈巴谷在異象中所見的神託：他說：
notes: 神言人 (God's-spokesman) renders H5030 נָבִיא (prophet); LCC uses a more literal calque than UNV's 先知 but referent is identical.
LCC expands H2372 חָזָה (to see prophetically) into 在異象中所見 — 在異象中 is LCC's unpacking of the vision-semantic inherent in חָזָה and has no separate Hebrew word; only 所/見 receive tags.
所<WAH0834>見<WH02372><WTH8804> mirrors UNV's 所<WAH0834>得<WH02372><WTH8804> with 見 substituted for 得 (both render the Qal perfect of חָזָה).
：他說： is a LCC discourse marker (no Hebrew equivalent in v.1) — left unannotated.
神託 renders H4853 מַשָּׂא (oracle/burden), functionally equivalent to UNV's 默示.

Hab/1.lcc_sn: 永恆主<WH03068>阿，我向你呼救<WH07768><WTH8765>，而你不<WAH03808>聽<WH08085><WTH8799>，要到<WAH05704>幾時呢<WAH0575>？我向你<WAH0413>哀呼<WH02199><WTH8799>「遭強暴<WH02555>！」而你不<WAH03808>拯救<WH03467><WTH8686>，要到幾時呢？
Hab/1.lcc_original: 永恆主阿，我向你呼救，而你不聽，要到幾時呢？我向你哀呼「遭強暴！」而你不拯救，要到幾時呢？
notes: UNV's introductory 他說 is absent in LCC — no tags needed for it
永恆主 = LCC's rendering of יהוה (WH03068); tagged at phrase end
First 向你 in LCC (我向你呼救) has no Hebrew preposition counterpart in that clause — the Hebrew שִׁוַּעְתִּי is absolute with no explicit אֵלֶיךָ — left untagged
Second 向你 (我向你哀呼) maps to Hebrew אֵלֶיךָ (WAH0413) in the second clause
LCC's 聽 maps to UNV's 應允, both rendering שמע (WH08085)
LCC quotes the cry as 「遭強暴！」— WH02555 attached to 強暴 within the quote
LCC adds a second 要到幾時呢？ at the end with no UNV or Hebrew parallel in that position — left unannotated; confidence lowered accordingly

Zeph/1.lcc_sn: 以下是永恆主<WH03068>的話<WH01697>，就是<WAH0834>當猶大<WH03063>王<WH04428>亞們<WH0526>的兒子<WH01121>約西亞<WH02977>執政的日子<WAH09002><WH03117>傳<WAH01961>與<WAH0413>希西家<WH02396>的玄孫<WH01121>亞瑪利雅<WH0568>的曾孫<WH01121>基大利<WH01436>的孫子<WH01121>古示<WH03570>的兒子<WH01121>西番雅<WH06846>的。
Zeph/1.lcc_original: 以下是永恆主的話，就是當猶大王亞們的兒子約西亞執政的日子傳與希西家的玄孫亞瑪利雅的曾孫基大利的孫子古示的兒子西番雅的。
notes: 耶和華<WH03068>→永恆主<WH03068>: LCC systematically renders the Tetragrammaton as 永恆主; SN attaches to 永恆主.
{<WAH0834>} is implicit in UNV (no Chinese word for אֲשֶׁר); LCC's 就是 makes the relative/connective particle explicit → braces dropped, attached as 就是<WAH0834>.
在位的時候 → 執政的日子: LCC uses 執政 (govern) vs. UNV 在位 (reign); WAH09002 (בְּ prefix) and WH03117 (יוֹם, day) both attach to 日子.
臨<WAH01961>到<WAH0413> → 傳<WAH01961>與<WAH0413>: LCC uses 傳 (transmit/convey) for הָיָה (came) and 與 for אֶל (to/unto); split maintained.
以下是 is an introductory phrase LCC adds with no Hebrew equivalent → left unannotated.

Zech/1.lcc_original: 大利烏二年八月、永恆主的話傳與易多的孫子比利家的兒子神言人撒迦利亞、說：
notes: LCC omits 王 (king title) — WH01867 (Darius) attaches directly to 大利烏 with no gap
UNV 第二 (ordinal) → LCC 二 (bare numeral); WH08147 attached to 二
耶和華 → 永恆主: LCC's rendering of YHWH; WH03068 transferred intact
臨<WAH01961>到<WAH0413> → 傳<WAH01961>與<WAH0413>: verb-preposition pair mapped word-by-word to LCC's 傳與
先知 → 神言人: LCC circumlocution for נָבִיא (prophet); WH05030 attached to the full 神言人 phrase

Mal/1.lcc_original: 神託永恆主的話由【1】瑪拉基【1】經手傳與以色列。
notes: H1697 (דְבַר, word) is implicit {braces} in UNV but LCC has explicit 話 — braces dropped per rule 3
LCC restructures the opening phrase: 神託(H4853)永恆主(H3068)的話(H1697) differs from Hebrew word order מַשָּׂא דְבַר יְהוָה but each term aligns semantically
由 receives WAH09002 (inseparable preposition בְּ, by/through); 經手 receives H3027 (יַד, hand) — UNV folds both into single 藉
Footnote markers 【1】 flanking 瑪拉基 preserved in original position; SN inserted immediately after the word before closing marker
